name: Sit in the Peaceful Garden of the Chickadee Cottage in LoHi
description:
Enjoy the famous Colorado weather and unplug in indoor & outdoor living.
Our charming cottage has a serene ambiance throughout every area.
Spend a sunny afternoon out on the hammock or enjoy the garden parlor sofa relax, read, or play a game, sink into the shared hot tub, practice yoga on the deck.
We are located next to downtown and in the neighborhood of lower highlands,
Short walks to superb coffee shops, restaurants, microbrews, distilleries, dispensaries & downtown. We are 420 outdoors only. LGBT Friendly, allergy-free, fragrance-free & pet-free. Ozone sterilized.

Chickadee Cottage is the largest of our guest cottages.

LOCATION:
The cottage is located in the center of Lower Highlands (LOHI) next to the Navajo Street Arts District along with the Bug Theater. Check out the Bugs listing to see what's going on - plays/film/comedy nights. No need to cab it because we are in the midst of it all.

COTTAGE DESCRIPTION:
neighborhood_overview: The cottage is located in the center of Lower Highlands (LOHI) next to the Navajo Street Arts District. Catch a show at the iconic Bug Theater. Wandering the neighborhood to discover breweries, distilleries and bars for local drinks, tuck into a family owned taqueria or explore more formal dinning experience. We are a vibrant neighborhood in Denver where you can see and do but just a quick walk thru the park to downtown, or a mile drive to RiNo. We are just 2.5 mile walk or dirve to Meow Wolf.
amenities: TV with Hulu, HBO Max, Netflix, Roku
host_about:
We are artists and tinkerers.
 
We enjoy many activities here in Denver -  cooking, growing fruits and vegetables are some that we get to do here at the cottages along with mixed media projects and furniture building. 

We are always up to some new outdoor project when the Colorado weather permits and hunker down inside by the fire in the winter keeping our hands busy with knitting, card making or some other project we can dream up.   In fact the most recent outdoor project is for an outdoor parlor that will be winter friendly. 

Giovanni and I have grown in our collaborations and embrace our age and abilities  for self governance in employment - Giovanni had moved into documentaries and I have been spending more time in the commercial film community. 

We have been in the lower highlands for over a decade now and have marveled in the changing landscape and exciting times for new restaurants, breweries and galleries.  We still love to take advantage of the great walks thru the neighborhood and down by the river as often as we can.

name: Lodo / RiNo LOFT  via airport train
description: Modern 1,000 square foot loft in the heart of RiNo, the hottest neighborhood in Denver right now.  Breweries, coffee shops, restaurants - all close. The 500 sq ft. patio has panoramic views of the Rockies.  3 blocks away from airport train stop.
neighborhood_overview: Ten brewpubs within walking distance, two great restaurants within two blocks and dozens more restaurants/bars/coffee shops within 4-5 blocks.   It's close to downtown without all the traffic & congestion.
host_about: I travel pretty frequently, I spend a lot of time in the mountains of Colorado and San Diego.

name: Comfortable  - and a great value!
description:
Large guest room in my home, where I also live. I have breakfast foods for nightly* guests to help themselves to. If 3 people share this room, one sleeps on the couch in the room.

*as opposed to weekly or monthly. Weekly and monthly guests are also welcome to help themselves to breakfast food their first of couple of days.
neighborhood_overview: I love the diversity of my neighborhood and its proximity to shopping and restaurants.  I live on a beautiful parkway.
host_about:
I am friendly and I love meeting people from all over the world.   I have received guests from over 33 different countries so far, in 14 years of being an Airbnb host.  I'm easy going and easy to get along with.  Staying with me can be like staying with a friend of a friend, in that I am glad to try to take care of your needs, and give you pointers about Denver, or also happy to leave you alone and grant you all the privacy you want (tell me.)  I have no pets, but occasionally I dog sit for my grandpuppy.  I speak French well, Spanish so so, and I remember a bit of German. 

As a traveler, I love to go places, stay a while, and interact with locals.  I love using Airbnb to travel and like to stay with hosts who also live in the property.  I enjoy just walking around, getting a feel for a city, trying its foods, meeting people and visiting museums (more than only just seeing the big tourist attractions.)  I think I am adaptable and an easy and appreciative guest.   I love to speak French, practice my Spanish and even try to resurrect my long-forgotten German.  I always like to try to learn to say at least please and thank you in the language of any place I visit.

description: Private studio with separate entrance in historic neighborhood. Great for a few nights or months! Less than 10 min to Denver Health Medical Center, downtown, Broncos Stadium, Ball Arena, Performing Arts, Coors Field.  Walkable to breweries, coffee shops, restaurants, SoBo, and Santa Fe Arts District.  One block to the Moss and two  blocks to the Space Gallery (wedding venues).  Easy access to major freeways and RTD.  Fast WiFi, fully equipped kitchen, washer/dryer, easy street parking.
neighborhood_overview: Walking through the Baker historical neighborhood you will find a little bit of everything -- grand Victorian houses, quaint duplexes, small single-story homes, and newly-built condos.  It's an easy walk to restaurants, coffee shops, breweries, the shops and Mayan theater on Broadway, and the Santa Fe Arts District with gallery openings the first Friday of each month.
amenities: Clothing storage: walk-in closet, closet, and dresser
host_about: I've had the good fortune to travel to many countries.  I always appreciate staying in a homey place.  I hope you'll enjoy my place as a home away from home.  Just let me know me know if you need anything during your stay.  Please let me know about when you expect to arrive, and if you know already, about what time you plan to check out.  Enjoy your journey!

name: Alexandra's King Bed Room Long-term Only
description: Thank you for visiting my King Bed Room site! This room is upstairs in my home. The bathroom is immediately adjacent, and it is shared with host and the laundry room. King Bed Room guests have the option of adding a twin-size trundle bed for an additional $15 per night.  Guests have keys, so there is no curfew. Parking on the street is unrestricted for up to 72 hours by using parking permit (available for $20 deposit).
neighborhood_overview: I love my Uptown neighborhood, which is within 2 to 3 miles of just about everything there is to do in Central Denver. There are six nearby grocery stores, from the basic to the gourmet, in walking distance. There are a number of liquor and fine wine stores, multiple coffee shops and Internet cafes, Denver's many beautiful parks, and numbers of great and some renowned restaurants and eateries for breakfast, brunch, lunch, tea, dinner, and dessert. Churches, many beautiful and historical, abound, and many offer some of the most beautiful music and the most interesting services and dialogues around. Shopping opportunities, too, are many and varied, from the adjacent Downtown area, to nearby Cherry Creek Shopping Center and Cherry Creek North, to various outlet malls and stores further afield. Good antique and flea market venues are found throughout the Denver Metro area. Entertainment venues are close by. They include sports venues for the Denver Broncos, Nuggets, Outlaws, and Barbarians
amenities: Dove, Dial, Safeguard, and Neutrogena's Rainbath, as well as moisturizing pump hand soap. body soap
host_about:
Denver native, former teacher, musician, chaplain.  Spent 4 years in Bolivia and speak Spanish.  I love my home and its location so close to everything.  My neighborhood keeps growing upscale, but my home remains surprisingly quiet!  My single family home is a true oasis in the city. 

Seven wonderful grandchildren and their parents make my life a blessing. 

I have really enjoyed welcoming and getting to know my guests from all over the world and the USA, and look forward to many more!

there is some history behind the cottages -
they were built in the 1890s and used to belong to a horse and carriage business that shuttled workers down to Union Station. our neighborhood has always been a working-class neighborhood starting with the Italians and then has welcomed many other waves of immigrants.

The Lower Highlands district is a thriving area due to the of proximity and the number of attractions that you can walk or bike to.

Bike paths are plentiful and you could tour the whole city on them.
you can rent a bike with a swipe of your credit card- Denver has a bike renta

Many exciting and innovative restaurants are located in Highland, including Root Down, Dimestore Delibar, Linger, Maine Shack and Littleman Ice Cream.

name: Washington Park Stunning Townhouse
description:
Beautiful Townhouse located blocks to Washington Park (Wash Park) quick and easy access to downtown.



Easy walk to Light Rail, Whole foods and park. Amazing property with great deck with Mtn views. Attached Garage, interior is spectacular. Great place to get away in Denver and enjoy the park and the city.
neighborhood_overview:
ABOUT THE NEIGHBORHOOD/LOCATION:

- Its Wash Park – just look up wash park and Denver and you will get lot of information for this location.

- It is a premier location for the city, with great access to Denver’s most highly rated park, easy access to downtown and Cherry Creek.

- Restaurants, bars and other stores very close, but not close enough to affect noise or any level of inconvenience or crime.

TRANSPORTATION & PARKING:
- Light Rail is 3 blocks away and run’s directly downtown in less than 15 mins or to DTC in less than 15 mins.

- Easy to get to the house from the airport, easy to locate.

name: Private room in the nest - w/bathroom
description: Private small room with own bath on the 2nd floor of a historic building in Baker. Walkable to 5 different coffee shops, shopping, theater, bars, galleries, ice cream, restaurants, distilleries & breweries. All the toast and jam you can eat. This is a cozy internationally influenced home in Denver with a long time Denver resident host. I am an entrepreneur, artist and traveler. I love meeting and hosting guests, but also can give you plenty of space. There is a large but sweet dog in the home.
neighborhood_overview:
The place is in Baker District, within walking distance is the Santa Fe Arts district and the south Broadway district.

The Santa Fe arts district to the west has 1st Friday events, many many galleries, several breweries and a few very good Mexican Restaurants, one of which has one of the best patios in Denver, El Noa Noa, and the other, El Tacos de Mexico, just won a James Beard award for classic places.

To the east is the South Broadway area which is filled with shopping, restaurants, bars, a vintage movie theater, ice cream, salons, Walgreens, a yoga studio, thrift stores, coffee shops, book stores & several breweries. Restaurants range from pizza by the slice, to a few notable dining establishments that won’t disappoint.

There is also a rec center 1 block away with a swimming pool, weight machines and basket ball courts that one can purchase limited use passes to. Across the street is a city park with a playground and basketball courts and lots

name: Private room In the heart of Denver

If you're  willing to walk a few more blocks you can also  access to Denver Art Museum, Kirkland Museum, Clifford Still Museum, the 16th Street Mall. amenities: Please check with us before using oven

David, with his community organizing skills, has been key in making the neighborhood the attractive and welcoming place it is today.  We feel lucky to live where we do - close to restaurants, theatres, parks, not to mention great neighbors right on the block. We love to share our bounty with visitors.

name: Creative Haven in Artist’s Abode
description: This two-bedroom, two-bath house is filled with treasures, trinkets, art, and oddities from around the world. Features a spacious front yard, patio, cozy corners, large kitchen, and unique curios from near and far. Curious adventure seekers and art aficionados will delight at this special space!
neighborhood_overview: The Clayton neighborhood is a rapidly changing area. A historically Black neighborhood of Denver, in the last decade the neighborhood has been experiencing significant gentrification. Many people in the Clayton area actively participate in neighborhood initiatives to help build relationships and engage in mutual aid efforts with our neighbors. For visitors to the neighborhood, a smile and a kind greeting can go a long way to connecting with folks you might encounter on your walk to the local coffee shop!
host_about: Artist and entrepreneur. I’m a writer, performer, traveler, and former nonprofit director working in the disability field. I’m curious about rocks, dinosaurs and mass extinction events, the evolution of languages, cultural mashups, emergency management, outsider art, puns, strange foods, and much more!

name: TreeHouseSuite, in Healing Center ~30 DAYS OR MORE
description:
A lovely get-away with a private garden entrance & bathroom, glowing eastern light and a writing desk. Enjoy the peaceful vibration resonating from in-house healers.

Carla Madison Denver Recreational Center across the street. Great walkability to restaurants, parks and movie theater. Easy access to B-cycle rentals, walking or bus - just a block away on Colfax!
neighborhood_overview:
The City Park neighborhood of old mansions is in the process of revitalizing and is known for it's conscious minded schools, i.e. 'The Nutritional Therapy Institute' and 'Massage Therapy Institute of Colorado'.

Across the street is East High School and the brand new Denver Recreational Center with daily passes available.

We are located 2 blocks from DenverFilm Center Sie Theatre, Tattered Cover Bookstore, City Park, and several bars and restaurants.

Across from City Park is the Denver Museum of Nature and Science. Six blocks N are the Botanic Gardens, and a mile further is the Cherry Creek shopping district.
host_about:

Awaken Healing Center is where healing and transformations become a part of community. I provide historic office space for creatives, healers and visionaries, and help them to bring their service to the world with ease. 

'SkyView Loft' and 'TreeHouse Suite' are located within Awaken Healing Center. Both are rented exclusively to tenants 30 days or longer.

name: 1890 townhome in popular LoHi! 2018-BFN-0009355
description: Perfect space/location for longer term visitors. Cozy townhome within walking distance to best neighborhood in Denver. Stay in a fully equipped home, ready for grilling in the backyard or heading out to amazing local restaurants.
neighborhood_overview: LoHi is one of the fastest growing, hottest neighborhoods not just in Denver, but in the country. The neighborhood has several of the highest rated restaurants in Denver, and is walkable to other neighborhoods as well, including Platte Street, Union Station/LoDo, RiNo and the Highlands. Much of the neighborhood feels very residential, yet you can be at a great watering hole, coffee shop or restaurant within just a few minutes' walk.
host_about:
I have been lucky to have traveled extensively, volunteered worldwide and because where you lay your head at night can be such an impactful part of your travels, I'm always looking for opportunities to create a welcoming and comfortable place, whether you are vacationing, stopping on your way through or working remotely.   

I grew up in the Midwest, lived in Chicago for several years, and now love the mountains as much as I love all my favorite destinations, from cities (San Francisco, Chicago, London) to mountain towns (Aspen, Crested Butte and Telluride) to international bucket list destinations (Mt. Kilimanjaro, Mombasa, Marrakesh).

I believe that travel is the key to understanding different people and different cultures, and I have learned that people are fabulous all over the world! 

Our goal is to make your experience feel tranquil, rejuvenating and special. Like you're home (but not!)  Feel free to follow me on IG: @vjarstad and on FB: Valerie Jarstad.

name: Cozy Central Loft -Walkable to Everything - 2BR
description:
Amazing location on a quiet street, yet a block away from shops, restaurants, and a large park. The loft is in a peaceful area of a busy neighborhood. Very central to all of Denver. Put away your car keys and explore this awesome little nook of the Mile High City.

Inside the place are hardwoods, high ceilings, and a cozy environment to relax. Inside the large bathroom there is a washer/dryer and great water pressure for showers. The kitchen is stocked for cooking, baking. Home away from home!
neighborhood_overview: This loft is at the edge of Denver. We are close to dozens of dining options; from an award winning cocktail bar to a ramen shop. We've got classy French cuisine and fancy beverages, and we've got a kid-friendly pizza restaurant. Nearby are breweries, wine bars, tapas and rooftop views. In town for sports event? Nearby: Broncos stadium, Coors Field for Rockies games, and the Pepsi events center are all super close.
amenities: Paid parking lot on premises  1 space
host_about:
I'm an active mom living in Denver. As an avid traveler myself, I love getting to know new cities. I set my place up to be as comfortable as possible while visiting Denver. You, feeling at home, is important to me.

"One of the best ways to make yourself happy is to make other people happy; one of the best ways to make other people happy is to be happy yourself."

I love music (piano and a couple guitars always around the house)... sport (water and snow skiing, basketball, biking, hiking & climbing)... books, movies and good conversation.  I travel most for work but enjoy exploring Asia, Europe, S America etc.  Italy is a must if you have not been.

name: Urban Retreat with Private Bath
description: Indulge in a room that is exceedingly comfortable, dreamy and private. The room with bath is in a stylish townhome in Denver's Lowry neighborhood. Guests share with the host use of the kitchen, laundry, patios and wireless Internet.
neighborhood_overview:
Developed in recent years on a former Air Force base, the Lowry neighborhood is a mixed-use community that retains many historic buildings. Sidewalks and pedestrian paths connect several parks. Spruce House, as I call the place, is located about a one-quarter-mile walk (or drive) from the town center, which includes restaurants, coffee houses, a grocery store, shops and other commercial outlets, as well as a bus stop. The Wings Over the Rockies museum is also nearby, as are a public library, post office and gyms. The Eating Recovery Center is just steps away.

Lowry is less than 10 minutes by car from the Cherry Creek shopping area and the United Airlines Flight Training Center, less than 15 minutes from the Anschutz medical campus, less than 20 minutes from downtown and approximately one-half hour from Denver International Airport.
host_about: I’m originally from Louisiana, so I offer hospitality with a Southern twist. I’m a Denverite by choice and I edited a travelers' guide to the city in a prior life, so it's my pleasure to introduce the city to travelers. I collect folk art -- both at home and when I travel -- so my home is decorated with carved animals and Spanish Colonial-style images of the saints, as well as textiles from faraway places and books on related topics.

name: Private lower level 2 bedroom suite
description: NOT 420 (marijuana) friendly. Our private ground level suite has 2 bedrooms, 1 bathroom, access to a coffee bar (kitchenette) and a living room area. It is roomy, comfortable and clean.  We live upstairs and rent the finished basement.  Common areas include the back door, back yard and laundry room.  Our house is in an upscale neighborhood, convenient location close to public transportation and off-street parking. the ceilings are low, so extra tall people (over 6'1") will be inconvenienced.
neighborhood_overview: Our neighborhood is upscale.  We live near the 17th Avenue parkway with mansions and lovely gardens.  A 1/2 mile away on East Colfax are entertainment venues, ethnic food, urban shopping and coffee houses. Its a 20 minute ride to downtown Denver where there is an array of urban excursions to be had. There is a gas station a block away, a drug store 2 blocks away and 2 large grocery stores 4 blocks away.
amenities: Free driveway parking on premises  1 space

Apartment-sized fridge with a freezer is dedicated to our guests. refrigerator
HDTV with Amazon Prime Video, Disney+, HBO Max, Hulu, Netflix, Roku, DVD player
One portable Dux induction burner is available induction stove
host_about:
My husband, Chris and I are empty nesters.  I am a landscape oil painter and a graphic designer and he is in logistics. I transplanted to Denver in 1979 from Bucks County PA and Chris moved here in 1984 from Buffalo NY. In our blended family we have four grown-up children and five wonderful grandchildren.  

We enjoy simple evenings, a card game with good friends, blues/rock music, great ethnic food and mountain drives / hikes. We don't drink or party at all anymore; just appreciate life, belly laughs, friends, family, each other and our spoiled puppy, Rufus.  

I am always busy working, socializing, hiking, painting, and cooking. We have simple taste and prefer road trips and staying at other Airbnbs, to tourist traps and luxury hotels. We watch a lot of football (we are Buffalo Bills fans) and hockey and are addicted to tv sagas on Netflix. I love art and come from a long line of artistic people.

Our motto is "One day at a time."

name: ZEN! Location! Cute,Quiet,nosmoking,CLEAN!
description:
**The community fee is for Wifi and linens. Guests who bring their own bed and bath linens will receive a $40 refund.
Our cozy and comfortable one bedroom apartment has a fireplace and air conditioning. It is bright and cool in the summer and warm in the winter. Located in Denver's top neighborhood, it is a 1.1 mile walk, bike, scoot or ride less than a mile to downtown and most all city attractions.

30 Night Minimum Required- No Exceptions
Maximum Vacancy between guests is 5 nights.
neighborhood_overview:
THIS IS THE BEST LOCATION IN DENVER: My house is in a quiet tree lined neighborhood, with free parking. It is also a short 1 mile walk to the center of Downtown. There is no car needed for a full vacation with a huge variety of entertainment, food, parks... Walk out the front door and two doors down and you are at restaurant row. At your feet are seven restaurants and a casual bar. Within one block distance is Humboldt Farm Fish Table (a top-rated restaurant in Denver), 7-11, and Qdoba. Walk another block and you will find Starbucks, coffee shops, fast food, bars, restaurants, sushi, and shops.

Our neighborhood is officially City Park West, but is also called North Capitol Hill, Uptown, and Whittier Heights. We are adjacent to Downtown, Capitol Hill, the Central Business District CBD, Five Points, Central, Cheesman Park, Congress Park, Curtis Park, Baker, Lincoln Park, and LoDo.
amenities: Paid parking lot on premises  3 spaces
host_about:
For an accurate picture of our rentals, check ALL of our 180+ reviews, that average over 4.5 stars.  We have been renting short term for over eight years, and strive to provide a peaceful, clean, quiet and joyful experience for all guests.
We live in Colorado and enjoy the outdoors.  We love to hike, ski, swim, garden, camp, and cook.  We travel as much as possible and usually end up in the Yucatan or the Colorado mountains.  Denver and the Rockies are spectacular and keeps getting better year after year. 
 
Our house has been in our family for two generations, and will someday be passed down to our children.  In the mean time we are enjoying sharing it with our guests and hope that you decide to give it a try.  It really is in the perfect location, close to everything and easily accessible to the mountains.  Se Habla Espanol.

Live, Laugh, Love!

name: Super-comfortable Modern Home 3 Bdr -Platt Park DU
description: Beautifully renovated 1800 s/f home. Contemporary architecture in a comfortable, open setting. Great light, chef's kitchen, comfy beds and nicer amenities. We are close to Steam Espresso, Platt Park Brewing, Sushi Den, Kaos Pizza, Old Pearl Street and DU/University of Denver - great for 1, 2 or 3 couples, families, and business travelers.
neighborhood_overview: Platt Park is a like a beautiful small town within the confines of our gorgeous and dynamic Denver, Colorado.
host_about: My wife Vicki and I have lived in Denver since the early 1980's (Vicki's from Iowa, I'm from West Texas). We love anything outdoors - mountain biking, camping, canoeing and scuba diving/beach-bumming :) We're foodies- Asian, sushi, great pizza, and Mexican in particular. We are coffee fanatics - I make espresso most every day and roast the beans occasionally.  We are accomplished cooks who enjoy entertaining, and appreciate good wine. We also enjoy great music - we're regulars at the Telluride Bluegrass Festival and Red Rocks concerts and especially love live music. And we love being airbnb hosts! Because of airbnb we have met the most amazing, delightful and diverse group of people imaginable.

name: Cozy Capitol Hill Accommodation
description: Private entrance into a cozy place with a  fully equipped kitchen and all the conveniences of home.  We have lived in this place for two months, so everything is there for your longer stay. Clean and comfy with private laundry and big closet. Good wifi and access to the outdoor space on the porch or when we are gone or at your request, our beautiful patio.
neighborhood_overview: We love the convenience of living within walking distance of three grocery stores, countless bars and restaurants, and downtown. Walk to the Denver Art Museum, Historical Museum, and all that downtown has to offer.
host_about: We love living in the heart of Denver. We are active city folk who love to get into the mountains. We are parents, gardeners, readers and enjoy entertaining friends on the patio.

name: Stylish & Historic LoHi Loft w/ Views and Parking
description: Our beautiful, light-filled one bedroom loft awaits in a super desirable part of Denver.  Ideal for two guests, located in the heart of LoHi.  Enjoy an open kitchen with large island, private outdoor space, and high end furnishings.
neighborhood_overview: This neighborhood is so cool!  So close to downtown but feels very neighborhoodsy.  Tree lined street with close proximity to cool restaurants and shops.  Easy access to public transportation and I-25, I-70, etc.
amenities: 42 inch TV with Amazon Prime Video, Fire TV, Netflix
host_about: I'm a Denver transplant by way of Connecticut, DC, Honolulu, NYC and originally New Orleans.  I love beautiful old buildings, dabbling in interior design, and sharing my little slice of heaven in LoHi.

name: Congress Park Cottage
description: Quiet Congress Park Cottage with great deck and within walking distance of trendy Colfax and upscale Cherry Creek. House was built in 1914 and sits back from street so is very quiet. Nice garden in  front and small lawn adjacent to house. Neighborhood is filled with WW I era craftsman cottages. 3 Parks within walking distance (City, Cheeseman and Congress).
neighborhood_overview: 1900s era Congress Park, one of the most desirable neighborhoods in Denver.
amenities: 21 inch TV with Amazon Prime Video, standard cable

name: DENVER SUITE MOUNTAIN VIEW GREAT LOCATION
description: DENVER SUITE WITH A MOUNTAIN VIEW: live in the very heart of downtown and enjoy a beautiful and peaceful mountain view!  Fully furnished 2 bedroom / 2 bathroom suite with an open plan living/dining room furnished with contemporary leather furniture and original artwork.  Perfect for an extended stay for a small family or a business traveler.
neighborhood_overview:
IDEAL LOCATION: Walk out of this suite, take the elevator down, step through the lobby and you are THERE, truly in DOWNTOWN! The Performing Arts Center is just a half-block away. The Convention Center is just two blocks away as is historic Larimer Square, with all of its restaurants, cafes, bars, deli/coffee shops. On the corner is Sam's Diner, open early and late which offers up a true slice of city life and great people watching.

Everything else is an easy walk, including the Pepsi Center, Platte Valley, Union Station, the Denver Art Museum, the Clyfford Still Museum, Museum of Contemporary Art, Coors Field baseball stadium. Confluence Park (REI, river walk and kayaking) Elitch Gardens Theme Park as well as Tattered Cover bookstore and many other sporting and cultural attractions.
amenities: Exercise equipment: free weights, stationary bike, treadmill, workout bench
Shared outdoor pool - available seasonally, heated
host_about:
I enjoy the hospitality. 
I love to share my passion for local history, attractions, outdoor activities, and beautiful scenery with our guests. I like helping our people to plan their vacation. We try to provide great customer service, a clean and safe place to stay.  Thank you to all our guests and repeat customers!

name: Private apt in Berkeley, MTN Views!
neighborhood_overview: Our homes are situated in the Berkeley neighborhood which is filled with beautiful parks,  lovely vistas, exceptionally outstanding restaurants and charming boutiques. This is a park like property with lots of room and every space on Airbnb has a private entrance,  bathing facilities and cooking facilities.   It is also very easy to access all the practical services from grocery stores to hairdressers  to cleaners to beauty treatments,  yoga and pet services. It is about 10 minutes by car to the downtown performing arts center and it takes just under an hour to reach the Loveland skiing/ snowboarding area ( which we love.) Convenience,  comfort and the charm of a small town all amazingly close to the delights of downtown Denver and wonders of the Rockies.
host_about: I love people of all ages and types, dogs, long walks, great music and books. For years we have enjoyed hosting students from all over the world and now that most of our children are grown, we have lovely spaces to welcome travelers and visitors to Denver. description:
CLOSE TO 3 HOSPITALS AND BEAUTIFUL CHEESMAN PARK!!!

This is a cute little suite of 2 rooms, one medium sized bedroom and a small attached alcove at the back. The rooms face south so there's lots of bright sunshine streaming in during the day, block out curtains at night. Cheesman Park and the Denver Botanical Garden are 1.5 blocks away. Fifteen blocks from downtown Denver, approximately 1.5 miles from Cherry Creek, 1 block from 2 major bus routes. Lots of shopping and nightlife nearby.
neighborhood_overview: The house is located in the heart of Capitol Hill.  The neighborhood was developed during the Victorian era, so the houses here are beautiful.  I love the old-growth trees and the lovingly tended gardens all throughout the neighborhood.  In addition, just about everything of interest in Denver is only minutes away, great restaurants and pubs, music venues, parks, libraries, museums and the Denver Botanic Garden.

neighborhood_overview: The Platt Park neighborhood is one of the most popular in Denver because of its cozy residential feel that also offers a fun main street (S. Pearl St.) with shops, restaurants, coffee bars and a weekly farmers' market.  We are close to light rail stations, Denver University and Wash Park.  It's hard to find a neighborhood that offers the safety and comfort of a quiet residential area while being so centrally located and boasting easy access to the highway and downtown.  We absolutely LOVE living here, and you will love it too!

name: Spacious 1928 Bungalow near Sloan's Lake.
description:
This 1928 bungalow has 5 bedrooms, 2 full baths, 2 TV spaces, great outside patio with grill and gas fire pit and trampoline.

Room to socialize and to find privacy with 2400 sq ft. Easy access to I 25, and I 70, the Broncos Stadium, downtown, bike trails, Red Rocks, Sloans' Lake and the light rail. New Restaurants and breweries all walkable.

There is also space and 🛜 to work from “home”.

Off street parking.
neighborhood_overview:
Our home is on the west side of Denver and is a rapidly changing neighborhood. Walkable to several new venues, restaurants, breweries, a public house and lake activities. Along with the basics of a supermarket and Target.
We have quick access to I-25 and I-70 and highway 6. Making access to Red Rocks, Blackhawk, the mountains, Broncos Stadium, and downtown very easy.
We are located 2 blocks north of the light rail, 2.5 blocks south of Sloans Lake.
host_about: Hello Future Guests! We love Denver and hope you will too. We have been providing our home for Airbnb guests for almost 8 years. We have been Superhosts for most of that time.  We are users of Aibnb when we travel and love staying in other wonderful homes.  We love hiking, swimming, biking, art, knowledge, and fun.   One of us likes decorating, especially with street art and one of us is very handing at fixing up our home. One of us likes sewing, quilting, jewelry making, and cooking.  One of us likes making stained glass, carving, and drawing.  We both like reading (a lot).  We both love our children and grandchildren. From San Diego to New York City, our grandchildren are the reason we have such a kid friendly home.  We have a labradoodle who sheds minimally and who travels with us.  Come stay with us and have a super vacation!

name: 2BR - West Highlands Sweet Retreat!
description: Our recently updated West Highland Sweet Retreat is just 2 blocks from Sprouts, 24 hour fitness and Tennyson Shopping District!   We have added a 55” Smart TV in the Living Room and each room also has TV’s with streaming capability!  This is the perfect location for visiting grandparents, family and friends!  Easy access to major highways and Downtown as well as major sporting events and concerts! Sorry, we are strictly non-smoking, non-partying, no pets.  We like to keep our neighbors happy!
neighborhood_overview: We love the diversity of the neighborhood, the abundant victorian homes that can still be found throughout adjoining neighborhoods, the proximity to cultural events, sporting events,  boutique shops, unique restaurants and being in a state where microbrews can be sampled at many of the nearby bars! Did we mention that skiing is only an hour away!
host_about: Breckenridge is one of our favorite places to unwind and we try to do it as often as we can!  When we can't, we love sharing our condo with others to experience the sereneness and seclusion that our property offers!  Other places we absolutely love to visit are Costa Rica, Hawaii, the Domincan Republic and Mexico!

name: Park Hill Denver: Shady Retreat
description: Visitors say my home is like a cozy retreat. Chatty birds greet me in the morning and a fine bakery/cafe, wine bar, bus stop, and Johnson & Wales University are an easy stroll away. Quiet tree-lined street with convenient access to DIA and Downtown.

Favorite Travel Destinations 
-- Rocky places (preferably vertical and/or volcanic): Iceland, Colorado, Ecuador, Peru, Sicily)

A distinctly urban neighborhood emerging from a colorful and gritty past, the Bluebird District is an eclectic business and entertainment district at the center of historic Colfax Avenue where edgy meets entrepreneurial and independent meets community.

Distinctly urban neighborhood: The neighborhoods on and along Colfax Avenue have seen struggles, and success, because of the dense urban mix inherent in their design. A diverse offering of housing uses and types, a mix of commercial offerings and operations and Colfax’s use as a primary transportation thoroughfare make it distinctly urban, and the Bluebird District is a microcosm of this.

The Bluebird District: The name “Bluebird District” has gained tremendous recognition since its inception a few years ago, after the historic Bluebird Theatre that anchors the district. neighborhood_overview:
The Neighborhood: Platt Park
At the turn of the 20th century, the Platt Park neighborhood—then a separate city from Denver—was a bustling borough of five-and-dime shops and sprawling family homes connected to the city by a clanking trolley line that ran up Pearl Street. As the Mile High City grew, the neighborhood was incorporated, and Denverites migrated south to make it their home. Today, the neighborhood’s storied history is still visible on Pearl Street, where visitors can glimpse trolley tracks peeking through the asphalt overlay, and new shops and purveyors occupy the original, historic buildings.

name: Modern Guest House in Berkeley Lake
description: Just a few blocks away from great restaurants, bars, shops, parks and even a lake, this airy, well appointed guest cottage is a cozy spot to enjoy our amazing city and neighborhood. Come visit the mile high city and relax at night in our quiet urban casita. With easy access to I-70, this is also a great jumping off place to explore the mountains.
neighborhood_overview:
Our neighborhood is great. And only getting better! It's set out far enough from downtown that driving and parking isn't an issue, but it's still only a 10 min ride/cab ride to all downtown has to offer. It has it's own vibrant shop/restaurant district called Tennyson st with great coffee shops, tons of restaurants--and more opening every month. Sprouts grocery store that is a 5 minute walk from the house. We also have a beautiful lake and park a couple blocks away that offers great views of the mountains and a nice path if you want to go for a run. We are located only 5 minutes off I-70 so it's nearly a straight shot to get up into the mountains.
In the summer, you can walk from the house to Lakeside Amusement Park, one of the old-style amusement parks with wooden roller coasters where you pay per ride for a fun, nostalgic afternoon.

We have 2 dogs and you will often find us at a local restaurant/bar, the park or even just in the backyard spending time with the pups and our family. We enjoy the outdoors and we love the easy access to skiing and hiking that Denver provides as well as the young, active, friendly vibe of the people here. We look forward to meeting travelers and helping them feel as comfortable and at home as possible here in Denver. We also love traveling and really getting to know the areas that we visit including the people and culture of new cities. Airbnb provides a way to immediately immerse yourself in a new place and we love that.

Uptown and City Park West are the Perfect Locations for experiencing all the Denver has to offer! This house is very close to everything in downtown Denver. Great value for the location. The walk score is 94 and the bike score is 100! B-cycle rentals are across the street. Walk out the front door and two doors down and you are at restaurant row. At your feet are seven great restaurants and a casual bar, Olive and Finch Bakery, 7-11, and Qdoba. Walk another block and you will find Starbucks, Einstein Bagels, coffee shops, fast food, bars, restaurants, and shops.
Bike rentals are available across the street and all over the city through Denver's state-of-the-art B-Cycle program. Walk a quarters of a mile to 16th Street Mall shopping, lower downtown Denver nightlife, cultural centers, a mile to the Colorado Convention Center and one and a half miles to the Pepsi Center. Short/cheap cab ride to everything. Street parking only. No pets and No smoking is allowed on the property.

For an accurate picture of our rentals, check ALL of our 180+ reviews, that average over 4.5 stars.  We have been renting short term for over eight years, and strive to provide a peaceful, clean, quiet and joyful experience for all guests.
We live in Colorado and enjoy the outdoors.  We love to hike, ski, swim, garden, camp, and cook.  We travel as much as possible and usually end up in the Yucatan or the Colorado mountains.  Denver and the Rockies are spectacular and keeps getting better year after year. 
 
Our house has been in our family for two generations, and will someday be passed down to our children.  In the mean time we are enjoying sharing it with our guests and hope that you decide to give it a try.  It really is in the perfect location, close to everything and easily accessible to the mountains.  Se Habla Espanol.

neighborhood_overview:
One of the coolest and most conveniently located neighborhoods in Denver, this house is right off 6th and I-25, yet far enough from traffic to be quiet and homey.
The Santa Fe Arts District isn't as polished and gentrified as many other neighborhoods in Denver. No big chains and fast-food restaurants on Santa Fe or South Broadway, but plenty of breweries, restaurants, theatres, and more!
One caveat, the neighbors on both sides are musicians. I've never had any noise complaints from tenants, but want to warn those who may be light sleepers or sensitive to noise, this Art District home may not be right for you (especially on the first friday of the month).

neighborhood_overview:
RiNo or River north is an amazing neighborhood which was formally an industrial warehouse district. It is filled with art galleries, studios and other creatives... it is known for it's graffiti art festival with murals visible all year round.

17+ craft breweries, distilleries, cideries and wineries in one-square-mile, Check out the “Drink RiNo” list. Within 2 blocks of the house 7 restaurants, 6 Microbreweries, a Winery, a Distillery, a recreational MJ Dispensary, and Curtis Park. Foodies search: "Where to Dine in the Hot RiNo Neighborhood".

neighborhood_overview: This is one of the oldest neighborhoods of Denver. All the houses have character and charm. It is fun just to go for a walk. We live just a block from many great restaurants, and our go- to coffee shop "St Marks". There are restaurants all along 17th street! Just 5 blocks from both - City Park and Cheeseman Park, where we love to take the dogs, go for a run, rent a bike or paddle boat for an hour or so, or picnic on a summer sunday night to listen to live music. The Zoo and Botanic Gardens are in walking distance. During the summer months the Botanic Gardens hosts amazing, intimate concerts in their outdoor amphitheater. If you're here during this time you should check out their calendar. There are several other concert venues in close proximity, too. Less then a 10 minute commute to both Downtown Denver and Cherry Creek North or Cherry Creek Mall. Close to several other old town neighborhoods with small shops and tons of restaurants.
host_about:
Scott Hemerda is a founding principal and owner of Vacation Rental Collective (VRC), offering premier vacation rentals along the Front Range, including the greater Denver metropolitan area.  As a native Coloradoan, Scott spent his childhood in Littleton, studied at Colorado State University in Fort Collins, and raised his family in Parker. His daily commute to downtown Denver led to a love of the city in addition to his established love of the surrounding suburbs and mountains. Scott worked in financial services as the Director of Institutional Relationships for 18 years at TIAA-CREF, where he managed relationships worth 20 billion in assets. In addition to leading the top performing relationship management team, Scott supported and retained clients through challenging service model and system changes all evidence of his superior relationship management skills.
Scott married his high school sweetheart and they have three children. A lover of sports, he instilled the values of collaboration, teamwork, and good sportsmanship as a role model participating in softball and basketball and then as a coach for all of his children in their numerous activities. Scott grew up skiing and now enjoys hiking and exploring the mountains with his wife. Business trips, family vacations, and romantic getaways have cultivated his love and expertise on the needs of vacationers.

description: This impeccably remodeled 1930's charmer is located in one of Denver's most coveted neighborhoods, Wash Park West. Walking distance to some of Denver's best restaurants and coffee shops.  Thoughtful touches, modern, yet timeless, decor, high ceilings, light & bright. Includes Central Air Conditioning, full kitchen, washer/dryer!
neighborhood_overview:
The Vibe: Local spots where urbanites and nearby residents—mostly 20- and 30-something renters, young-families, and homeowners—hang; foodies visiting the hood’s rich and varied selection of eateries; joggers finishing their loop at the adjacent Wash Park.

Grub: Head to the French-inspired Vert Kitchen for homemade sandwiches (try the curried chicken), or a fast-casual brunch. (Or not so casual: They also sell bottles of champagne.) For Greek food—a genre that’s a little sparse in Denver—Pete’s Central One is a mainstay. Wash Park West is also a great destination for Asian cuisine, and Thai Basil, although a chain, serves up the best green curry in that neighborhood. Next door, Fontana Sushi rolls up creative specials, like the Spiderman, which adds extra crab, spicy mayo, and eel sauce to the already scrumptious Spider roll.

Get Some Work Done: Head to the cutely named Wash Perk for a home-away-from-home spot to pull out the laptop. The wifi is password-free, the

neighborhood_overview:
This is the historic 5 points neighborhood and adjacent to the Rino Arts district that is one of the hippest upcoming neighborhoods in Denver. It is blocks from the light rail to get around the city. City Park and Downtown are walking distance (roughly 2 miles to the center of downtown, but less than a half mile to many bar brewery and restaurant options).

Since this neighborhood was built in the late 1800s and early 1900s, there is a lot of great architecture throughout, so it is nice to just take a stroll around the neighborhood. With plenty of neighborhood restaurants and bars, you can always find a place to get some food or a drink as well.

Please feel free to ask for recommendations or more info about the neighborhood.

There's a major grocery store (with one of the area’s cheaper gas stations) just two blocks away. Super easy access to I-25 and I-70, too!

Further afoot, a longer walk or fun bike ride gets you into downtown Denver, LoHi, the Highlands, West Highlands, Sloan's Lake, or the CU Denver/Metro State U campus.

I guess you could say I traded the beach for the mountains. You wouldn't think there would be much volleyball in the Mile High State but there is! Denver is the first place I ever lived in which I truly felt home. I hope you feel the same when you step into my humble abode.

My other favorite thing to do - travel. I enjoy exploring new cultures and immersing myself in them. Best thing I've seen so far - Northern Lights in Iceland and Alaska not to mention aerial trip to Denali! I'll send you some pics of them if you like :)

neighborhood_overview: We are located in the Congress Park neighborhood in Denver.  This centrally-located historic area provides fast and easy access to many Denver attractions.  The Denver Zoo, Denver Museum of Nature and Science, and the City Park are between 1-2.5 miles north of our place.  The Denver Botanic Gardens is just under a mile west of our place.  A variety of restaurants and coffee shops are easily within walking distance.  Quaint neighborhood shops are just two blocks away (12th Ave and Madison St), featuring a home decor/gift shop, liquor store and pharmacy, full service salon, coffee shop, ice cream shop, wine bar and pizza and Mexican restaurants.
host_about:
Hello!  We are an interracial (white/black) married couple raising two boys in the heart of Denver, Colorado. For ten months of the year Will works as a high school teacher of vocal music. For the other two months (summer break!) he enjoys taking care of our boys, gardening, doing house projects and cooking.  Jess, a former high school science teacher, is now a data coordinator for the genetic counseling department at a cancer center in the metro area. She enjoys baking sweets, papercrafting, reading, hanging out with our kids and getting together with friends.  Together we love hosting dinner parties, traveling and improving our home.  We generally prefer the arts over athletics, liberal/progressive views over conservative ones, and down-to-earth honest folks over high-maintenance people.

As a guest, we are very respectful of others' property and space.  We are moderately interactive with hosts, making conversation when suitable or needed, but also relaxing in the privacy of our room.  We are friendly, calm, and low-maintenance.

We look forward to meeting you!

We are focused on the traveler and the traveler's needs and believe something being affordable should still offer exemplary service and more than expected perks. name: Cozy, vintage Baker home just 1 block off Broadway
description:
Fully furnished Chic/Modern/Industrial Home: 2 bedroom/1 bath, just one block from all of the South Broadway restaurants, shops and bars - located in the heart of the artsy & hip Baker neighborhood...yet still very quiet and comfortable. It is just 3 miles south of downtown. One street parking pass available for your vehicle is included. *no parties of any size allowed please

Short Term Rental License: 2019-BFN-0004823
neighborhood_overview: Baker, or South Broadway is a very artsy and unique neighborhood in Denver offering very eclectic restaurants, shops and bars. Just off Broadway, our house is within walking distance to all the action, however still a very quiet space. It is just 3 miles south of downtown so if you plan to go downtown it is just a quick 10 minute uber away.
host_about: Hi there! I have been an Airbnb host for over 10 years now! I grew up in New England, live in the city of Denver, Colorado now but the mountains of Summit County are my second home. Traveling around the world and experiencing new cultures is one of my biggest passions in life and I do it as often as possible. I’m so grateful to be able to share my homes with you and hopefully make your trip a memorable one!

name: Stylish 2 story unit in Victorian Mansion
description: An 1886 Victorian brick mansion, updated with modern convenience and style. This unit spans two floors with a master suite upstairs, bath with jetted tub & skylighted shower. There's a second bedroom on the main level with full bath (also w/ jetted tub) just outside the bedroom. The sleeper sofa has a memory foam mattress. The TV has a Netflix subscription & other channels through a Roku. Wireless is screaming fast. There is a private deck through french doors with a skyline view.
host_about: I am a real estate broker and mortgage broker. I enjoy Colorado by skiing, hiking and attending concerts. Have travelled throughout the world and appreciate meeting people and enjoying life.

name: Friendly Lic 04172
description: My place is within walking distance to many dispensaries, Sloans Lake, restaurants, Joy Ride Brewery, bars and dining. You’ll love my place because it is ### friendly. No smoking cigarettes inside. Pot is legal in Colorado so you may smell a faint odor of pot just sayin. My place is 23 minutes or 14 miles from Red Rocks amphitheater, 20 minutes or 13 miles from Dicks sporting goods Park, 11 min or 7 miles from Coors Field, 9 min or three miles to downtown Denver. Guests under 18 not allowed.
neighborhood_overview:
Make yourself at home and relax, you are among friends and neighbors!
When you exit the complex through the front gates, take a right to get to the lake, 25th St. Joyride Brewery, many dispensaries and restaurants.
You will notice the Mexican bakery, hair stylist and nail salon across the street (Sheridan) on your left before the 7-11 store. Other eateries are down along the lake on your right. Rupert's is my favorite, and is only open for breakfast and lunch.
Barbershop and one day spa are also down Sheridan just past Starbucks, as is Northern Lights dispensary. The other way on 29th is my favorite day spa A new spirit 4840 w. 29th.
Catch the #28 Eastbound bus in the covered bus shed by the lake across the street from 7-11. Fare is $2.60 and includes a transfer. This takes you downtown where you can catch the free 16th St. Mall Shuttle. Catch the #28 bus Westbound to return home on 15th St. The drivers are all very helpful as are other riders.
host_about: In the winter I spend my time skiing in Vail, CO. In the summer I live in one of my Airbnb units in Wheat Ridge CO. In the summer I bike, water ski and travel. I love meeting new people and sharing my home with others. I really enjoy using the Airbnb experience section. Live life to the fullest.

name: Lucia's 2bd/1ba | 30 Day+ | Dog Friendly
description: Meet Lucia, the little pup who call's this home unless she's sharing it with you. Lucia's house is not too big or small; not too close or far from downtown, the mountains, or the airport and it's in the heart of Denver.  Lucia's little house boasts big charm, great neighbors, and nearby eclectic food options and markets, Little Saigon. You’ll love the location of our little home while you're here.
neighborhood_overview:
"Named after the famed P.T. Barnum of Ringling Brother’s and Barnum Bailey’s Circus, the Barnum neighborhood is located in West Denver. Legend has it that P.T. Barnum purchased the land to house his circus animals in the winter but this neighborhood was never used for that purpose." Denver Library website

This neighborhood is a lovely place to call home. Barnum Park is just up the street and great to take a walk, enjoy the downtown cityscape, or just watch the city pass you bye.

Little Saigon is south on Federal Blvd. We recommend that get your pho "phix" at any of the various local noodle houses. Enjoy the local Asian and Mexican markets and make it an adventure!
amenities: Free driveway parking on premises  2 spaces
host_about: I am a 42 year old looking for a nice holiday from my two businesses I run. I am a Licensed Counselor and a real estate broker. I have a dog, Willie Nelson, and I live between Denver and Trinidad, CO.

name: Denver Highlands Haven
description: Well established listing with all new modern furniture and more! 2BR / 1BA comfy, bright, and private home w/ washer/dryer. Walk to Broncos Stadium, Highlands Restaurants, LoHi, Downtown! 25min to DIA airport & Mountains.
neighborhood_overview: Located in the Highlands neighborhood, this 'Highlands Haven' is just a 5 minute walk to Highland Square with The Matador, Solitaire and Sushi Hi.  Or head on over to Duo for a romantic night out.  Oh, you'd like some Mexican food - head on down to Chili Verde for some French influenced Mexican food and fantastic margaritas...so good!
host_about: Friendly Denver native and real estate professional.  Enjoy golfing, swimming and summer evenings on a patio with friends.

name: Room Upstairs @ Eric's HipFunPad
description: A sweet pad located on Tennyson St in one of Denver's hottest neighborhoods with restaurants, breweries, bars, shops, coffee and parks within 6 blocks. This is a shared apartment above the owner’s e-bike shop. I sleep in the upstairs master bedroom, but you’ll only see me coming and going since I practically live in my bike shop downstairs.  Just over 3 miles to downtown. Upstairs at Eric's is relaxing with a covered patio, great sound system, chalk wall, movie projector, drum kit + more.
neighborhood_overview: There is hardly any reason to leave the neighborhood if you don't want to. This house is right on charming Tennyson Street - almost a mile long thriving cultural district with a wide variety of bars, coffee shops, restaurants, art galleries, live music venues, shops, parks and less than a block away from a Natural Foods grocery store.  There are four restaurants on this stretch listed on Westword's "100 Restaurants We Can't Live Without" issue.
amenities: Sound system with Bluetooth and aux
host_about: I work in live entertainment production and have lived in Denver for nearly 30 years.  Most of that time in the house in my listing.  The house is a 1893 duplex built with an upstairs, 2 floor apartment and a main floor apartment.  I used to rent out the downstairs apartment, but now I live down there and only use the upstairs apartment when it's not rented out here.  My first drum kit is upstairs, and it's still my favorite of all I have owned.  Feel free to use it if you rent the Upstairs@ Erics listing.  I also rent out a private room in my main floor apartment which is shared full time with me.  Bicycles are my other passion and I enjoy converting regular bikes to electric bikes in a part time business I run from my front room.  Ask me about ebike rentals or tours! I really do enjoy sharing my comfortable space with people from all over the world on AirBnB.

name: Modern Sanctuary 1 Block from Mountain View Parks
description: Just a half-block away from a cluster of walkable parks with great mountain views, this sanctuary is the perfect balance between nature and urban living. We love this home because of its spacious feel and the copious amounts of sunlight and windows. The home has a carport, meditation/exercise room, wood-burning fireplace, in-home projector, and hot tub! We hope that you will enjoy the Rosedale neighborhood and its residential vibe while still being connected to urban attractions.
neighborhood_overview:
We hope that you will enjoy the Rosedale neighborhood and its residential vibe while still being connected to urban attractions.

Walkable to:
-Harvard Gulch Park
-City of Kunming Park

-#1 Best French Bakery in the metro-area

amenities: Private hot tub - available all year

name: New Modern Home in West Highlands
description:
Gorgeous modern home steps from the Tennyson St. bar and restaurant district. Open floor plan with 14 ft ceilings oak floors and high end finishes. 92 walking score! It's all right here including new grocery store and the best night life of any Denver neighborhood.

10 minutes to downtown via 38th ave.

NOTE: You can find a cheaper place in this neighborhood but we spent a bit more time and money to deliver a higher-end option. Check our reviews for unbiased opinions of the results.
neighborhood_overview: This community has been featured in Travel + Leisure Magazine as well as National Geographic Traveler. The 250-acre section northwest of downtown has experienced amazing growth over the past few years and is widely considered the best spot in the city. It's packed in every direction with trendy restaurants, bars, and shops. Three diverse commercial districts - Lower Highlands (LoHi), Highlands Square and Tennyson Street make Highlands Denver's largest neighborhood.
host_about: Avid traveler who will treat your place at least as good as you do.

name: Private Entrance Guest Suite with parking
description: Your space is in the basement of our home with a private keyless entrance and includes a private off street parking spot IF REQUESTED IN ADVANCE. Lyft or Uber, are never more than a one or two minute wait. Downtown is within a 20 minute walk. Smoking is allowed outside (420 friendly).  Your suite is self contained with everything you need to be comfortable.  You will receive your entry code on the day of your arrival after we have your arrival and departure times.
neighborhood_overview: The best part of our neighborhood is that everything is within walking distance of our home, including downtown Denver and Cheesman Park.  Our porch is a great place for visiting and people watching.
host_about: I'm a Denver native. Attended college in Pennsylvania at IUP. I love to travel and host my own place as well. My passion is Photography.

name: Downtown/Ballpark/Walkable/Top 11 Airbnb in Denver
description: This historic, 4-level, stylishly decorated 768 s/f, 1 bedroom/1 bath loft is located in the Lodo/Ballpark neighborhood. It's recognized by the Denver Business Journal as one of the top 11 Airbnb rentals in Denver. It offers all the comforts of home and is within walking distance to, Coors Field, Union Station, 16th Street Mall, plus numerous restaurants, bars and microbreweries are just blocks away.
neighborhood_overview: The Lodo/Ballpark Neighborhood is a walker's / bicyclist's paradise, located close to unique restaurants, bars, microbreweries and shopping. Coors Field is 4 blocks east, Union Station is a short walk, and the 16th Street Mall is 6 blocks south.
host_about:
As a mortgage broker for the last 19 years, I love learning and thrive on trying new things.  I am so excited to share this unique space with my guests.

If I was given 3 wishes, I would ask for good health, the ability to travel, and that every new day would be better than the last.  You could say that being a happy and energetic person tops my list of must do's.  

My favorite place on earth is San Diego, California, with it's culture, people and variety of food.  Whenever I visit, I always feel like I have a grounded spirit.

As a host, I am available whenever needed,  just ask.  Otherwise, enjoy your stay and please plan on coming back to visit soon.

name: Entire Apartment Denver DTC - Long term only.
description:
My place is good for Family, Nurses, Business travelers, Consultants, couples, solo adventurers, and families (with kids). Place is quite close to Denver Tech center.

We are looking for Long term stay - 30 days minimum.

As per our apartment regulations and Denver city - I can only sublet long Term and minimum requirement is 30 days. We would not lease apartment for shorter periods.

The place is a single bedroom apartment.
neighborhood_overview: Its very close to DTC, hospitals, equi-distant to Denver downtown and parker, Highlands ranch. There are parks and golf course around.
host_about: I am Sharath

name: Cozy remodeled Highlands Apartment
description: Remodeled basement apartment in a historic 1907 home;  a great mix of old and new. This unit has its own exterior entrance and is located in the fabulous and fun Potter Highlands neighborhood. It is only 1.5 miles to downtown, all the major sports arenas/stadiums,  and Union Station. We do live upstairs most of the year and you will likely hear our footsteps (but we can't hear you).
neighborhood_overview: Centrally located in the popular Denver Highland Neighborhood and within walking distance to over a 100 of the most popular restaurants, bars and unique boutiques in Denver. It is a quiet neighborhood considering its fun and lively location. Union Station, Pepsi Center, Coors Field and Sports Authority Field at Mile are all within a 1.7 mile walk or bike ride. B Bike rentals are only few blocks away. Red Rocks Amphitheater is 16 miles
amenities: 42 inch HDTV with Amazon Prime Video, Chromecast, Netflix
host_about: We both love music, spending time outdoors and making our home feel 'like home'. Tom has been a  musician since he was a kid and spent the past 20 plus years owning his own landscape design business. He is responsible for our beautiful yard! Heidi works in wellness and loves art, adding special touches to our home. You will likely find us camping or visiting family when our home is filled with guests.

name: Monthly rental in University Hills

The house is carpeted except for kitchen dining room and baths. There is nice yard with a covered patio. Parking is in the driveway or on the street.
neighborhood_overview:
The neighborhood is convenient to many areas of Denver. It is near Hampden and I25 and is walking distance to a light rail station and bus line.
Any shopping, restaurant or service is close by.
host_about: We are experienced hosts and are eager to assure that you enjoy your stay.  We love to travel and have used short term rentals on many occasions. We think that homestays are a great way to travel and we enjoy getting to know our hosts and our guests.

name: Artist 1bdrm home. Heart of Rhino! Near Downtown.
description: Local artist  1 bdrm townhome. Located in Denver's newest art district.  5 minute drive to downtown, Walking distance to restaurants, bars, art galleries, nightclubs and live music venues. 1 block from lightrail station and only steps away from bus stop.  Parking space provided.
neighborhood_overview: Very close to downtown! Neighborhood park is 1 block away.  Lots of new restaurants in the neighborhood. Neighborhood is know for street art, so it's a good area to walk around and take in the art.

name: Cozy and bright modern 2 bedroom in West Wash Park
description: The perfect spot for your next adventure, my home is a relaxing space on a quiet street but close to all the action!  A quick walk to the shops, bars and restaurants on trendy S Broadway, a mile from Wash Park, and 2 miles to downtown (on a bus line with a direct route) makes my home an ideal home base to explore this amazing city! Parking included, modern space w/ amazing amenities! End your day by falling into the comfiest beds!
neighborhood_overview: It's quiet and residential but close to the "hot spots" I love. It feels like easy city living!
host_about: I love to travel and have found airbnb to be the most amazing way to feel like a local in the cities I visit!  I love providing that same opportunity to those who are visiting my own city that I adore and want to show off!

name: Private Lock-off in RiNo (400+ Positive Reviews!)
description: Large, private studio with separate entrance, located in Denver's urban- industrial River North (RiNo) neighborhood.  Located walking distances from some of Denver's best restaurants, craft breweries, coffee shops, cocktail bars, and the world-class  RiNo Art District. This home-away-from-home is perfect for weekend guests looking to take advantage of all that Denver has to offer; and for weekday guests looking for a quiet retreat during work trips just outside of downtown Denver.
neighborhood_overview: Our home is in on the dividing line between the recently revitalized RiNo neighborhood and the historic Curtis Park neighborhood. The RiNo neighborhood is full of breweries, boutiques, coffee shops, bars, and restaurants, all of which are within walking distance of our home and ideal for daily fun. The Curtis Park neighborhood is mostly residential, with a number of parks and bike paths that are perfect for afternoon trips.  Because of our home's central location, you're just a short walk to Coors Field and Union Station. For those looking to explore beyond RiNo, Curtis Park and Downtown, hopping on a bike for 20 to 30 minutes, or taking a 10 minute Uber/Lyft ride, will quickly land you in Capitol Hill, City Park, Cheesman Park, Highlands, and Globeville.

name: Entire level, 4 min to Cherry Creek. Pet Friendly
description:
Entire lower level of home, 2200 sq foot space. Private. Fully furnished with bamboos floors throughout, huge windows with lots of light. Bedroom Large Den gathering space with TV, refrigerator and microwave.
Additionally, separate home office with desk. Also, exercise/yoga room with fireplace. You have your own private bathroom with shower and sauna. TV in den
Centrally located in Denver's Hilltop neighborhood adjacent to Cherry Creek& Glendale CitySet that has lots of really good restaurants.
neighborhood_overview:
Denver's Hilltop Neighborhood. 4 minutes to Cherry Creek Bank row. 5-8 minutes to Cherry Creek. 5 minutes to Glendale's CitySet.
Near multiple supermarkets and renowned restaurants. 10-20 minutes to downtown Denver. Pet Friendly
amenities: Exercise equipment: free weights, yoga mat
host_about:
I went to school in Switzerland where home sharing is common. It is such a pleasure to meet different people from around the world and welcome them into our home!
I love to cook, garden and, I ballroom and latin dance regularly. I also have been practicing yoga for 28 years.
Life in the Rocky Mountains is superb! The gorgeous mountains and spectacular weather make living outdoors easy.  We bike ride and hike a lot. I Look forward to meeting you!

name: The Highlands - Great Location!
description: Built in 1920, this mission style bungalow has been fully updated and transformed into a beautiful new space. Close to Highland's Square, Downtown Denver, shops, restaurants, cafe's and grocery stores. You’ll love of the location, the lovely neighborhood, the ambiance, and the friendly people. My place is good for couples, solo adventurers, business travelers and families (with kids)!
neighborhood_overview: Historic West Highlands is a beautiful turn-of-the-century neighborhood filled with interesting architecture, shops, restaurants and parks. We have included a lot of information in the welcome book that is located in the kitchen.
host_about: Hi! My name is Kenny. I'm from Denver, born and raised but love to travel the world. I e been to 28 countries as of 2024. When I'm at home, I enjoy working in my yard, spending time with friends, or taking day trips in Colorado. I work in a senior living community and that keeps me pretty busy too.

name: Denver Victorian Mansion Apartment
description: Enjoy this gorgeous freshly-renovated apartment in the back of my historic 1896 Victorian Capitol Hill Mansion. Cozy, comfortable, and in the heart of the city- just blocks to some of the city's best restaurants, concert venues, coffee shops, and parks!  We just completed a full remodel of the entire apartment, and everything from the furniture to the appliances and everything in-between is brand new!
neighborhood_overview: Capitol Hill is one of, if not THE best neighborhoods in Denver.  I've been fortunate enough to live here for the past 18 years and have enjoyed every minute of it.  The neighborhood is very safe, and with a walk score of 88 you couldn't hope for much more from nearby amenities, food, or entertainment.  The apartment is right in the heart of Cap Hill -just over a block to a number of restaurants (everything from fine dining to late-night pizza), 2 blocks to King Soopers (grocery store), and 3 blocks to Cheesman Park, The Ogden Theater, a few more blocks to The Fillmore, The Botanic Gardens, and a quick Uber or Lyft ride to downtown or Cherry Creek.
amenities: Brand new 5-burner gas stove! stainless steel gas stove
host_about: I'm a filmmaker and my wife Anne who helps to co-host, is in digital marketing. We look forward to hosting your stay in our favorite city!

name: Downtown Studio! Brooks Tower 6M
description:
Located in downtown Denver, this unit is in the thick of city action. Walk to Elitch Gardens, Pepsi Center, Coors Field, Empower at Mile High Stadium, historic Union Station, Denver Performing Arts Complex, Auraria Campus, and more. Fully furnished studio apartment with private balcony, DIRECTV, WiFi, outdoor pool, gym, billiards room, 24/7 front desk staff and secured building access. Southwestern exposure!

On-site laundry is currently limited, pick-up laundry service on-site is available.
neighborhood_overview:
Located in the Central Business District. Easy stroll to LoDo nightlife, bars, and restaurants.

Super Target just four blocks away. Take the FREE 16th St Mall shuttle to Whole Foods and King Soopers.
amenities: Shared outdoor pool - open specific hours, rooftop
host_about:
Thank you for considering one of our listings! 

Our company owns multiple units in the downtown Denver high rise, Brooks Tower Residences. When not in use for our corporate housing needs, we rent them to travelers on a 30+ day basis. All units are professionally managed by us and our in-house maintenance staff, and professionally cleaned in between guests.  Monthly rent includes a furnished unit, building amenities, all utilities, &Wi-Fi access.

name: Bed, Bath and Hot Tub with Private Entrance
description:
Peaceful, large bedroom/bath with private entrance off the gorgeous garden in 1930s vintage home. Close to several medical centers such as National Jewish, Rose Medical Center, Children's Hospital, and University Hospital. We are a few blocks from bus routes, coffee shops, concert venues (bluebird, Ogden, Fillmore) and fun restaurants.

fast Wifi, TV, microwave, fridge and hot tub. The room has a new king-size bed and self-controlled air conditioner/heater for maximum comfort. Not 420 friendly.
neighborhood_overview: We live in the Mayfair Neighborhood, just East of Downtown Denver, with many great restaurants, coffee shops and concert venues within a short distance. The best coffee shops near are Hooked and Bellweather on Colfax. Trader Joes is just up the street. Our favorite close restaurants include Chop Shop, Annies, Angelos, The Abbey and Jelly.
amenities: Pack n play/Travel crib - available upon request
Coffee maker: french press, Keurig coffee machine
Shared hot tub - available all year, open 24 hours
30 inch HDTV with standard cable, Netflix, Amazon Prime Video, Apple TV
host_about:
I am a happy, people person who believes that we can do wonderful things when we set the intention to do so. I am a Life Transformation Coach, helping people create the life of their dreams, along with a plan to achieve it. I am a Reiki healer as well and am happy to book a session with you if you are interested. Because I spent most of my life as an entrepreneur, I teach entrepreneurship full time at MSU Denver and love the job. While I do not believe my jobs defines me, I sure love teaching, coaching, and healing. 

Travel is my other favorite past time. I recently traveled to the south of France with friends and family where we stayed in a castle. After that, my awesome adult kids and I and walked a portion of the Santiago de Compostela in Spain. I travel a lot in the US and love staying at Airbnb locations. It is there that a person gets the true nature of the city/location.

5 Things I Cannot Live Without:

Travel
Water (beach, pool, river, hot tub, hot springs)
Bacon
Wine
People

I love hosting guests through Airbnb. We have an eclectic house full of charm and cool things. Our only pets are fish in a fish tank and Koi in a Koi pond. The energy in our home is peaceful and enriching and I am super excited to share that with others.

Because we have lived in Denver for a long time, we know all the good places to go—local coffee shops, unique boutiques, micro breweries. 

While the space is fairly private, having your own entrance and bathroom, we are happy to share the kitchen and laundry facilities, if you are interested. We looking forward to hosting you!

name: Modern and Bright LoHi Townhome, Amazing Location!
description: Stay in the heart of LoHi. Steps to the best restaurants, bars and shopping Denver has to offer. Also provides easy access to downtown and the highway to get you wherever you need to go. Of course, the house is also so comfortable you may not want to leave.
neighborhood_overview: LoHi is one of the most exciting neighborhoods in Denver. It is home to many of the best restaurants in town (we provide lots of recommendations in our home guide), as well as bars and shopping. Minutes from downtown and convenient to all parts of the city, it is the definition of centrally located. If you're coming to Denver to see a professional sports team, we are close to Coors Field (baseball), Pepsi Center (basketball and hockey) and Mile High Stadium (football).
amenities: 65 inch HDTV with Amazon Prime Video, Apple TV, Disney+, HBO Max, Hulu, Netflix, standard cable

name: Cute Carriage House (with bikes provided)
description: Private Carriage House with full kitchen, full bath, and lots of light - 20 ft ceilings with sky lights. Located in our backyard in a quiet neighborhood with easy parking just 2 miles East of Downtown - walk to Zoo, City Park, and neighborhood restaurants.  Or, bike (with provided bikes) to downtown, Cherry Creek, or RINO.  Easy access from Airport - just a 20 minute drive or Uber or the A-train and 7 min bus ride will bring you within 2 blocks of the Carriage House.
neighborhood_overview: We love living in Whittier.   We are walking distance to a tap room (Ephemeral) and two delicious restaurants, the Plimoth and Point Easy both just a few blocks away.  City Park, the Zoo, and the Nature and Science Museum are walking distance.  We are two miles from Downtown, which is a quick bike or bus ride/Light Rail ride away.  We are also a quick bike ride to RINO with its numerous new breweries and restaurants.
amenities: 42 inch HDTV with Roku, Netflix, standard cable
host_about: Hi, my name is Stephanie.  I retired from my job as a lawyer (doing Civil Rights work), and decided that now that I have time in my life, I would start renting the apartment in our back yard.  I enjoy everything outdoors that Colorado has to offer - skiing, biking, running, hiking, backpacking.  In 2015,  I hiked the Colorado Trail - from Denver to Durango (480 miles) and am currently section hiking the CDT.  I am an active volunteer, currently working several days a week at the local food bank.

name: Private Room & Bath Near Trails and Restaurants
description:
I’m a young professional opening up my home to visitors looking for a place to stay in the peaceful Central Park neighborhood of Denver, walking distance to popular restaurants and steps away from biking trails. My friendly, lovable dog, Shelby will happily welcome you as well.

Guests will enjoy the comfort of a private, quiet bedroom and a private modern bathroom with mountain views in a house filled with options to relax or have fun.
neighborhood_overview:
Central Park is a quiet neighborhood filled with beautiful parks and biking trails.

Stanley Marketplace is a 7 minute walk away. An 8 minute walk north will take you to a few additional popular restaurants and the grocery store as well.
amenities: Exercise equipment: free weights, yoga mat
TV with Hulu, Amazon Prime Video, Disney+, Netflix

name: Modern apartment in LoHi
description: This modern and spacious apartment is in the best area in Denver! It comes fully furnished with a king bed and option of adding an air mattress. Close to everything, quiet and spacious, it's perfect for couples, small families and professionals. Please note that this is located underneath our main house. We do our best to be respectful of our renters, and make a special effort to be quiet during typical sleeping hours. However, we do have two young children who sometimes have their own agendas.

Our family is very happy here, and we embrace our urban location. We take our boys to the park, let them play outside, and say hello to all our neighbors. We also live on a very friendly block, where everyone knows each other and gets along great. Our particular area is residential and doesn't offer many restaurants or bars, but it is just a short drive from all the best spots in the city.
