host_about: We're a busy family of four, so y'know, always on the go...There's me, Rebecca, writer, artist, and avid cook and gardener, though I seem to spend a lot of time building marble runs and lego art with our two 9 year old boys.  There's Charlie, handy energy engineer, awesome garden and rain capture system builder.  And then there are those boys I mentioned...let's just say there's a lot of climbing on the furniture, drawing, puzzles, books, fort-building, dirt-digging, and marble-rolling in our house.  But don't worry, our two guest rooms are located far from the mayhem in our fully renovated basement, otherwise known as "the fortress of solitude". Virginia Village is a friendly residential neighborhood in a central location with easy access to DU to the west, Cherry Creek directly north, and the Denver Tech Center due south. There is a local park a block away and the famous Wash Park just a quick drive west. We are 8 miles to Downtown Denver - an easy ride on the Light Rail.

One of our favorite restaurants is Ester's - just a four block walk where we get great craft beer options and the best pizza around. Neighboring areas have top rated restaurants within a 10 minute drive - Sushi Den & Bird in Platte Park - Jax Fish House in Glendale - Max's Gill & Grill & Perdida in Wash Park - Cherry Creek Grill & Cherry Cricket in Cherry Creek.
host_about:

I love getting creative with cooking and baking while Miles is always on the hunt for the best craft IPA. 

I've historically traveled for business and appreciate "the little things" when it comes to being away from home. As hosts, we are welcoming and want to be certain people are comfortable. We appreciate people that respect our home as if it was theirs. As guests, we like clean spaces with charm and great recommendations for great local fare.

We also enjoy great music - we're regulars at the Telluride Bluegrass Festival and Red Rocks concerts and especially love live music. And we love being airbnb hosts! Because of airbnb we have met the most amazing, delightful and diverse group of people imaginable.

name: The Denver Superloft! Industrial 2BD/2BA Sleeps 4!
description: Enjoy close proximity to Denver's best restaurants and breweries. Or stay-in and enjoy all the amenities: beautiful artwork from local Colorado artists, play some pool or watch your favorite events/movies on a 100" HD projector screen equipped with 7.1 theater style surround audio.
neighborhood_overview:
It's about a 15 minute walk to get to the breweries, galleries and restaurants in RiNo district. Or it's 8 minute walk to the 38th and Blake light-rail station which will take you either downtown or to the airport.

About a 5-15 minute Uber to pretty much everywhere else:
RiNo - 3 minutes
LoDo- 8 minutes
Uptown - 5 Minutes
Capitol Hill - 10 minutes
Wash Park - 15 minutes
amenities: 100 inch HDTV with Amazon Prime Video, Disney+, Fire TV, HBO Max, Hulu, Netflix, premium cable
Yamaha sound system with Bluetooth and aux
host_about: I'm Owen, a happy-go-lucky dude living in Denver, CO. I love traveling, dance music, and sharing in kindness with others.

name: Urban Perfection Historic Victorian
description: This is a beautifully remodeled queen anne victorian home that is on the quietest block in urban Denver.  The home, built in 1893 has all the old world charm with the modern conveniences you will need.  It boasts gorgeous crown molding, ten foot ceilings, a gas fireplace, Italian oak stairway, skylights, original leaded glass windows & a fully equipped gourmet kitchen with stainless steel appliances. There are 4 balconies & a 2 ½ car garage which is rare in this urban setting. 2016-BFN-0008675
neighborhood_overview: Located in the Baker neighborhood, the home is just a block from eclectic boutiques, fine dining, and some of Denver’s trendiest nightlife. Located just a 1/2 mile from light rail, and minutes from downtown Denver, this home provides the ideal location for exploring our majestic city on foot, bicycle or other transportation.

name: The Sunny Spot Near Downtown!
description: Welcome!  This spacious home has 5 queen bedrooms,  2 kitchens, 2 living rooms, 3 bathrooms, and a nice yard with hot tub. Enjoy all that Denver has to offer. This place is a quick uber ride to RINO, Downtown, City Park, Cherry Creek, 38th and Blake light rail stop, etc. Enjoy checking out restaurants, The Zoo, The Nature and Science Museum, The Art Museum, breweries, dispensaries or anything else. Centrally located and next to public transportation. Enjoy!!
neighborhood_overview: The Whittier neighborhood is nice.  The Whittier Pub is nice for a quick burger and beer.  Rino is close by with tons of breweries, and downtown has a little bit of everything.
host_about:
I’m originally from Iowa, but have been in Colorado for 15 years.  I love traveling and seeing new places.  Recently, I decided to switch things up.  Now, I live in Caye Caulker, Belize part-time.  Come check out this little slice of heaven!  
   Life is short-ENJOY!

name: Remodeled Old-World Home in Downtown Denver
neighborhood_overview:
Five points is a beloved old neighborhood in Denver. Situated in a prime location between RiNo and LoDo. It's a great place to see shows, hop around local breweries, and enjoy local art. The Curtis Park Deli is right around the corner, British Bulldog is right down the street, and with a short walk, scooter or Uber you can be at many of Denver's best restaurants, bars, and entertainment areas.

As this house is at the heart of the city, you will hear city noises, including emergency vehicles at times during your stay. Also, it is only a few blocks from the mission, so there are quite a few homeless persons in the area. I've never experienced any issues with them in the year I've lived here.
host_about: College basketball referee living in Denver. I love to travel, hike, ski, and get out into the mountains as often as possible.

name: Modern Living in the Heart of Downtown
description: Cute studio with hardwood floors, murphy bed, views of the mountains in the heart of downtown Denver. Just steps from everything you need!
neighborhood_overview: Located one block off the 16th Street Mall, you're located in the heart downtown Denver and most everything is walkable. The mile-long, pedestrian-friendly Mall is packed with shopping, restaurants and attractions.  Explore the historic Union Station for breakfast or drinks, check out the local Tattered Cover Bookstore on the 16th Street Mall, or get into nature with the Cherry Creek bike path.
amenities: Exercise equipment: free weights, stationary bike, treadmill
host_about:
A native Coloradan who lives in the mountains, I can appreciate both the hubbub of the city and the peace of the outdoors.  I'm a writer, a reader, a yogi, a mountain biker, a skier and a hiker, and my best days are when I get some adventure, some exercise and when I laugh with my family, my friends. My last Costa Rica surf trip is my favorite vacation right now, though I'm a fan of good old fashioned local backpacking trek too. 
My Motto: Be Nice.

name: Cherry Creek Studio Apt
description: Small Studio Condo right off the Cherry Creek Trail. Minutes from dozens of restaurants and shops on Colorado Blvd. Pool (during the summer) laundry facilities, and conveniently located off Colorado & Mississippi. Large King-sized bed and all-new stainless appliances. Ideal for couples, solo adventurers, and business travelers. 30-day minimum beginning in 2017
host_about: Born and raised in Denver, where I work in nonprofit media and technology. In my personal time, I make music and movies.  To supplement my nonprofit income, I manage a couple small rental homes.  I love to play tennis, ride bikes, swim, and travel!

name: Urban Retreat in Heart of Convention Center Dist
description: This spacious two story, three bedroom/two full bath, loft style city home is located directly in the heart of downtown Denver's Theater-Convention Center District. Complete with an amazing city view, it's the perfect accommodation for both business & pleasure.
neighborhood_overview:
Location, Location, Location! Located only two blocks from the CCC (Colorado Convention Center) in the heart of Denver’s Theater and Central Business District, this 3 bedroom/2 Full Bathroom loft apartment is perfectly located in the Center of everything Downtown Denver.

Guests have easy walking and public transportation access to so much of what Downtown Denver has to offer. The local neighborhood is lively and bustling with conventioneers attending events not only at the CCC, but at several of the city's large hotels many of which are also located in walking distance. The 16th street mall, spanning from Civic Center Park (Capitol Building area) to lower downtown/Union Station is only half a block away. In addition, if you're planning to see a game/concert at the Pepsi center, a show at the Opera House or Performing Arts Center, the Rockies play at Coors Field, the Broncos play at Mile High, or a visit to one of the many Denver Museums, they too are all within walking di
amenities: Pack n play/Travel crib - available upon request
Standalone high chair - available upon request
HDTV with Fire TV, Hulu, Amazon Prime Video, Disney+, Netflix, HBO Max, Apple TV
host_about:
Hello Everyone, My name is Michael.  I love traveling and staying in Airbnb's.  Thank you for your interest in my downtown Denver apartment.  

Michele is happy to help you with all of your questions before and during your stay!  Please send us a message or inquiry and she will be back in touch with you promptly.

name: Sloans Lake Row Home w/ Patio & Grill!
description: Make yourself at home in this 1 bed/1 bath urban retreat, nestled just steps from Sloan's Lake hot spots. This cozy space offers all the amenities of home: A well-stocked kitchen, washer/dryer, designated workspace, and a private patio for grilling. The local brewery and cafe are just three doors down. The home is also situated between two beautiful parks — and only a mile from Mile High Stadium near downtown.
neighborhood_overview:
The Sloan's Lake neighborhood is one of Denver's newest hot spots and Sloan’s Lake is within walking distance, just a few blocks away (across Colfax).

After a stroll along the lake, head to one of the nearby restaurants or cafés: The Patio, Odell Brewing, or ChoLon — or catch a movie at the renowned Alamo Drafthouse!

The historic Edgewater neighborhood is just west of the lake with even more great local attractions, including Rupert’s, Joyride and Sloan’s Bar.

The Highlands neighborhood is a 10 minute ride, as well as the ballpark & other downtown attractions. Empower Field at Mile high, home of the Denver Broncos, is less than a mile away.

I25 is 2 miles down Colfax - Jump on 6 to Red Rocks (a quick 20 minute drive) or to the surrounding area for some beautiful Colorado scenery in the foothills of the Rocky Mountains.

The local brewery, Seedstock, is three doors down from the house & you can often find food trucks outside.
host_about:
I love new places, new spaces & new smiling faces! Originally from Chicago. 

I can't wait to meet you!

name: Comfortable Business Travel Denver
description:
Dear Guest: I am no longer offering my condo on the Airbnb platform. I cannot support a business that does not subscribe to ethical business practices. I have decided to part ways with Airbnb after almost five years as a Super Host. As you can see by my many excellent reviews, I take hosting seriously and I do whatever it takes to make sure my guests are satisfied. You are welcome to contacting me directly or find my listing on a similar platform.

Warmly ,
Anna Forsberg

name: Bright, relaxing getaway
description: Like to ski, snowshoe, visit beautiful gardens or explore alternative medicine?  My place is close to the airport, parks and the wonderful Denver Botanic Gardens, and just a 20 minute bus ride to downtown. Walk, bike or run on the miles of paths thru Stapleton parks, accessible across the street.  I do have a lovely adult cat, Russian Siberian.  He does roam the house so if you are allergic that could be a problem.
neighborhood_overview: Stapleton is a planned community and is very safe.  We have miles of bike and walk trails that wander through lovely green spaces, and access to these trails is across the street from my house. The community is new, only 10 years old, and is home to predominantly young families and grandparents.
host_about: I am a somewhat retired grandmother, keeping busy with a garden maintenance business as well as volunteering with local garden societies.  Traveled to South Africa two years ago and intend to travel for the third time to SE Asia next year.  I am a relaxed host and guest, respecting your privacy.  Looking forward to meeting you.

name: Carriage House Loft,  History in central LoHi
description:
This beautiful historic building was built in the 1880s as a carriage house and converted into a living space in 2005. Brick walls, original wood floor, big wooden beams, gears and chains for the platform elevator.....this is not your everyday stay. This is a place like no other and smack dab in the middle of one of the hottest neighborhood in Denver. No need for a car at this place.


High Speed Internet ...100Mbps

License: 2017-BFN-0001262
Includes 10.75% Denver tax

No pets, No parties
neighborhood_overview: LoHi is currently one of the hottest neighborhoods in Denver. Tons of new and interesting restaurants and many holdovers  from "the olden days" when it was the Italian district.  In less than a mile you will find 5 of AirBnB's top 7 Best of the Best of Denver's bar/restaurants. (https://www.airbnb.com/things-to-do/denver) . Walking at night is safe and well lit.
host_about:
I'm a portrait and wedding photographer working and playing in Denver, Boulder and around the country and world. When I'm not working, I'm trail running in foothills, cycling wherever I can, or riding my horse into the sunset. So much to do and enjoy in Colorado. 

I love meeting others through AirBnB and am excited to share this unique space with other adventurers. 

Welcome!!

name: The Aristocrat - 3800 sqft Denver Loft w/ HUGE Pat
description: Searching for the highest standard of luxury for your trip to Denver? Look no further. Welcome to this gorgeous, newly renovated building right in the middle of all the action. You will have the entire spacious floor to yourself and will be just blocks from 16th Street Mall, the Colorado State Capitol, and the hottest dining and nightlife spots downtown. Modern and upscale, this top-line unit offers the best of Denver.

Downtown is also home to many of Denver’s top farm-to-table restaurants and innovative craft breweries, and the Denver Beer Trail is a great guide to sampling those local brews.

name: Queen Anne Victorian central Denver
description:
Spend a month in Denver this spring. Urban living in the heart of Denver. Updated and sunny 2300 sq. ft. private home built in 1886 available from April 13 to May 22 for period of 31 days or more.

Blocks from light rail to downtown. Walk to City Park, Historic Five Points, Cervantes, Queen City Collective, Point Easy and Whittier Cafe. The kitchen is updated and fully-equipped. Have coffee on the deck off the master suite, or enjoy the deck, patio, and garden off the sunroom.
neighborhood_overview: Whittier is one of Denver's oldest central neighborhoods with predominantly single-family housing and diverse population. The block is filled with a variety of types of friendly people who love city living.

name: Private Bedroom and Bath Close to Downtown
description:
***Please note: Solo guests only (1 person).***

Modern 2400 sq. ft 4 story townhouse in the heart of Denver's historic Five Points neighborhood. Located 10 blocks from trendy Rino arts district and 2 minute Uber or Lyft from downtown. Rino has some of the best new restaurants and breweries in Denver.

For business travelers, there is a light rail stop 1 block away and goes right downtown. Runs every 15 minutes. A stop 2 blocks from Convention Center. $2.60 each way.
neighborhood_overview: Restaurants, grocery store, liquor store and a brewery are a very short walk. Stores and shops and bars within walking distance, as are two light rail stations. Very close to trendy Rino district and downtown.

(I've been doing it for 4 years running). I like to bike and ski as well. I'm quiet and respectful when staying at AirBnb's, and am a host as well.

Welcome to your retreat on Capitol Hill. It has a private entrance. Located 2 blocks from Cheesman Park and within walking distance to The Botanic Gardens, Rental Bikes, Downtown, Museums, Coffee Shops, Grocery Stores and Restaurants.
The apartment is good for couples, solo adventurers, and business travelers.

Alejandro and I are San Francisco transplants, and loving the Colorado Lifestyle.

**30 days minimum**

Please send an inquiry first if you have questions or clarifications. I would love to answer them to make sure this is a good fit
host_about: Colorado native :) Travel, live music, hiking, making new friends, movies, yoga, running, bike riding, snowboarding, reading ♥️

name: Highlands Area Private Basement with Living Room
description:
You will have private access to the entire basement with your own separate entrance. The space includes a personal bathroom, living area, bedroom and laundry.

Our place is close to the RTD Bus line going to Downtown Denver, Union Station, Ball Arena, Empower Field, the Convention Center and Regis University. There’s plenty to see and do without renting a car!

Grocery/Liquor stores are less than a block away. Our place is good for couples, solo adventurers, and business travelers.
neighborhood_overview:
Our neighborhood is very popular in Denver. In the summer you can join in on First Friday festivities on Tennyson street which is 6 blocks away. We are across the street from the grocery store and within walking distance to many restaurants, bars and breweries.

Historic Tennyson street offers shops and boutiques galore. There is never a shortage of things to do. If you like being outdoors you have easy access to two parks that are within a mile away. Hiking can be found as close as 20 minutes away. There are bike paths and bus routes close to the house.

Popular venues:
Ball Arena (downtown Denver) is 4 miles making a Lyft/Uber ride very easy.
Coors Field is 5 miles away.
Red Rocks concerts and hiking is 18 miles away.
Boulder’s famous Pearl Street is 28 miles away.
Winter Park Resort is 65 miles away.
Copper Mountain is 81 miles away.
Garden of the Gods is 76 miles away.
host_about:
Hi! My husband and I live in our cozy little place and love it. It's centrally located and the neighborhood always has things happening. We are very active and love to bike and hike. There are so many beautiful places we enjoy going in our area.  We love traveling and have a long list of countries we want to visit.  We are adventurous and enjoy creating new experiences. 
My husband is a probation officer and I am a real estate investor.

description:
Enjoy breathtaking views of Denver from the 38th floor every single day!

Perfect for corporate rentals or professionals working downtown.

Minimum stay 3 months.

host_about:
Hello there!  I'm Ashley. 

I've been hosting on Airbnb for years now and absolutely love it! Personally I think it is because it has given us the opportunity to travel and see the world AND to meet amazing people like yourself and that's just freakin' cool. 

In addition to our own home, we manage a number of properties for others and guests from all over the world enjoy staying in our properties! That could have to do with how we strive to make everything perfect for you during your stay! 

I have a website with resources on planning your trip to Tulum - it's called Tulum Traveler - you can check it out for tips and recommendations. 

Wishing you a wonderful trip!

Cheers, 

Ashley

Inside you'll find a full kitchen set up, living room, kitchen, bedroom & bath. Cable Tv & Wifi also. Possible extended stay.

Check on multi month discounts. This LoDo property is just minutes from Larimer Square, Coors Field, & Union Station. It is also close to Elitch Gardens amusement park, Store, the Pepsi Center, the Convention Center, Illegal Pete’s, ChoLon Modern Asian Bistro, & many more restaurants & bars. Great for couples, solo adventurers, business travelers, & families (with kids).

Your hosts, Mike & Donna, were born and raised in Denver.  There's so much to do here, golf, tennis, biking, skiing, hiking, etc.  You’ll love the location, it’s central to everything. A short walk to Union station and a block off the mall.  Close but not too close, you’ll find it’s a very quiet location.  The view is toward Coors field and a portion of the mountains.  

Includes all utilities with HD cable TV in living room and all bedrooms.  

If you have any problems please let us know and we'll try to get it taken care of as soon as possible.

name: Nice house w/ huge yard in desirable Neighborhood
description: Across the street from Mayfair Park, near Montclair, Cherry Creek, and restaurants. This is the perfect size for a couple, business associates, a small family, or an individual who would prefer to use the second bedroom as an office. Large private backyard with grill, spacious kitchen, real wood floors, and washer and dryer. King in one bedroom, queen in the other. *Pets considered with an additional fee, must message me prior to booking for approval.
neighborhood_overview: Located near shopping, restaurants, short drive to Cherry Creek Mall and downtown.
amenities: 50 inch HDTV with Amazon Prime Video, Apple TV, Disney+, HBO Max, Hulu, Netflix, Roku, standard cable
host_about:
Hello, I work in the field of marketing and my husband, Tim, works in Solar. We are quite active and self-proclaimed foodies. If you want any recommendations on where to hike or eat while in Denver, we have some good recommendations. 

HOW HOSTING BECAME OUR PASSION:
Tim and I came into our relationship each owning a 2 bedroom house.  As our family grew and our needs changed, we decided to rent out both of our two homes because neither one of us wanted to sell. We gave short term renting a try and we’ve had such great experiences with the wonderful people we’ve met. It brings joy to know that our guests are enjoying our homes as much as we did. 

As a couple who travels quite a bit, we try to incorporate a high level of standards of what we expect in a hotel. Our ultimate goal and passion is to help our guests get as much out of their visit as possible, as there's just so much to offer in this unique and beautiful city. If there is anything that would make your stay more enjoyable, please reach out prior or during your stay. 

*I have contracted a translator for French and Spanish speaking guests to help arrange accommodations, if needed.

You’ll love my place because of the  1 comfy King bed and 2nd bedroom has  a queen bed and a double air mattress which you can move to another room, the high ceilings, the light, the kitchen, and the coziness. My place is good for couples with or with out children , solo adventurers, and business travelers.  License # 2020-BFN-0003037

An easy Uber to Downtown or Union Station means that you'll be out of the hustle and noise, but can pop in for the day or night and then comeback to a neighborhood quiet.15 minutes away from the airport and just a 90-120 minute drive to CO's beautiful mountains and resorts.

name: Cozy apartment, easy access to everything
description: Our place is within walking distance of Bronco's Stadium, Meow Wolf, Sloan's Lake, and the Lightrail station, which can take you to the Pepsi Center or downtown in less than 10 minutes. We are conveniently located close to both I-25 and I-70, making the apartment a perfect starting point, whether exploring the city or the mountains. The place is cozy and nicely decorated, and accommodates up to 4 guests. You are welcome to spend time in the backyard, and we have a couple of bikes available.
neighborhood_overview: We live in a changing neighborhood with a mixture of older, classic homes, and more modern constructions. Our house was one of the first on the block, built in 1900. description:

Nestled in our 1912 Arts and Crafts home, this apartment is open & spacious with comfy, elegant furnishings. A gas stove in the living room warms up wintry evenings.
We are a mature couple preferring a tranquil environment, so we seek an individual who shares these values. All is provided -Just bring a suitcase!
neighborhood_overview:
We are 10 minutes due east of downtown traveling by car on 17th Street. Directly to the west is the lovely Johnson and Wales campus just two blocks away, and Park Hill, one of Denver's oldest and most elegant neighborhoods is also to the west. Park Hill features some lovely parkways, including 17th Street, Montview Boulevard, 23rd Street and Monaco Boulevard; it is a nice place to walk. (And if you're really motivated, the Zoo, City Park and Museum of Nature and Science are about 2.5 miles west.)
To the north and south are the relatively newer neighborhoods of Stapleton and Lowry, with town centers, restaurants and cafes.
Going to the east, the neighborhoods are more transitional, but changing fast as they are now anchored by the newer and huge Anshutz Medical Campus. Not to be missed is the spanking new Stanley Marketplace, housed in a former airplane factory, with brewpubs and some of the most innovative new restaurants in Denver. I-70, the main route to the mountains
host_about:
Hello, thanks for taking the time to read about us.  I came from the beautiful Finger Lakes area in upstate New York, moving here at 18 years old because I "had never known until I came to Colorado that the sun could come out in winter. "  That being the case, of course I never left. Lynne is from Colorado, with great-grandparents who grew up in Georgetown and old Snowmass. Life back then was not glamorous and a living was cobbled together from gritty pursuits such as silver mining.  
We love beautiful spaces, the outdoors, art in its many forms, and the company of good friends.  One of our careers together has been restoring neglected historic homes, and our home has been an almost two-decades long work in progress.  Restoring the apartment was one of our earlier efforts, and as is usually the case, we found architectural clues as to what our home's earlier owners had been up to.  (Such as the enormous beams that proved the claim that our house had been moved from Denver Municipal Airport in 1928. That airport became the old Stapleton Airport. We also heard from a gentleman in his ninties that he had watched it being moved.)
We believe historic homes are living history, in real time.  Having modern amenities makes them all the more appealing.
Possibly our greatest love is travel.  We agree with St. Gus, who said "The world is a book, and those who do not travel read only one page." And of course our favorite part of traveling is and always will be connecting with people from all walks of life, from all around the world. We're so thankful to have the opportunity to do this once more through hosting. 
Wishing you safe and happy travels!

neighborhood_overview: The River North Art District "where art is made" goes by the nickname of "RiNo" and has even adopted a rhino design for its official logo, so look for creative rhinos in art and signage all around the neighborhood! Historic warehouses and factories now house jazz bars, restaurants, brewpubs, art galleries and working studios. RiNo boasts a diverse mix of creative businesses ranging from visual artists, designers and furniture makers, to craft distillers and brewers, winemakers, creators of unique outdoor gear and small-batch coffee roasters. The art definitely extends beyond gallery walls in this neighborhood, with its colorful and innovative street art murals in alleys and on buildings around almost every corner!

Originally built in 1912 this renovated, historical house is walking distance to Mile High Stadium. Close to LoDo, the Convention Center, Coors Field, Denver Zoo, Aquarium, Union Station, Pepsi Center, lots of breweries, and both the Art Museum and the Museum of Natural History.

Includes 5 bedrooms and the ability to sleep 16 comfortably and 20 with tight quarters, a large 2nd story patio and backyard, and full size arcade games. All races, religions, and LGTBQ are welcome here!
neighborhood_overview:
Located next to Viking park in the Highlands area there are a ton of restaurants and breweries within walking distance. Both Zuni St and Little Machine breweries are just down the block and are great places to enjoy a freshly brewed beer while checking out the local food truck.

For breakfast check out Sassafras ( call ahead as they fill up quickly), for lunch my favorite spot is Snarf's Sandwiches or Federal Bar and Grill. There are so many dinner restaurants it's hard to choose! Uncle for picture worthy ramen, Patzquaro's Mexican food, Sexy Pizza, Highland Tap and Burger, Wynkoop Brewing and Restaurant, or Williams and Graham (a cool speakeasy) which was rated the #1 cocktail bar in the country in 2016. It's also a quick 5 minute drive to downtown for great shopping during the day and great breweries, bars and clubs for a night out.

Pack n play/Travel crib - always at the listing
Folding or convertible high chair - always at the listing
Baby bath - always at the listing
host_about:
Born and raised in Colorado, but I bleed Maize and Blue.. I love to play soccer, basketball, axe throw, and am generally just happier doing anything outdoors.

As a balance, I enjoy trying new foods and craft beers, and am always happy to share brewery and restaurant recommendations.

I have a week spot for booze brunches,  definitely best meal of the day.

name: Awesome 2BR House at Park Hill, Denver Colorado.
description:
Sam’s home is located in the Park Hill neighborhood in Denver, CO, U.S.A. It is of the hottest & most desirable neighborhoods in Denver. Rated as Denver's best neighborhoods in 2017, as seen in Westword Magazine.

Conveniently located to choose your own adventure: nightlife in downtown, eat ethnic food along Colfax Ave, concerts & local breweries. Check out the New Stanley's Marketplace in Stapleton/Central Park a few blocks away.

Let me know how I can make your stay even better & enjoyable.
neighborhood_overview:
Lived in this house since December of 1989. It has a huge front and back yard with great public transportation.

There is a cool local coffee shops a short walk away at Oneida Park Center that currently has: Little Man Ice Cream, Spicy Thai, Famous Philly Cheese Steak & Beer Garden, Red Sauce, Allegra's Pizza, Zen Den Pet Spa. Park Hill Veterinary Medical Center, Oneida Liquors, Love Fashion Nails, Park Hill Motors, Flex Yoga + Barre.

The closest full-service grocery store is King Soopers at Quebec/26th with Starbucks inside the store. 3 blocks away from the house

The town center at Quebec/29th has a variety of restaurants and a few shops.

The Stanley Marketplace at 2501 Dallas Street has many more restaurants and shops.

Colfax Avenue has many restaurants and stores stretching for miles.

I will provide a list of my favorite places in the area
amenities: 46 inch HDTV with standard cable, Roku, premium cable, Netflix, Hulu, HBO Max, Fire TV, Disney+, Chromecast, Apple TV
host_about:
Hello,   I grew up in Asmara Eritrea. i have lived in Denver since 1982 because it's sooo awesome.  I love my house that I use for hosting and lived here since December of 1989.

Recently, retired from City & County of Denver. Now I’m a full-time Yoga & Meditation teacher. I have been teaching since 2010 on part time basis. YAY!!!

For fun I like to read, do yoga/meditation as much as possible and traveling around the world. I watch live comedy, go to concerts, check out restaurants and hang out with my family and friends doing all of the above!

name: Contemporary Victorian in the Heart of LoHi
description: This renovated home has three bedrooms and two bathrooms.  Chef's kitchen, comfortable furnishings, and a private fenced back yard are at your disposal. Centrally located in Denver's hottest neighborhood. Just blocks away from some of the best restaurants in town.  Easy access by foot, ride share, or public transit to downtown, sporting venues, and area attractions.  This house has old character with new finishes.
neighborhood_overview: Great city location in private home with its own private back yard.  While a fun city location, it is still quiet enough to enjoy the privacy and serenity of the area.  It is conveniently located near downtown area attractions including museums, Coors Field, Union Station, Ball Arena, and Empower Field at Mile High. All are within walking distance or a quick ride share. There are several of the best restaurants and bars in Denver just blocks away. This area has easy access to I-25 and I-70.

name: Riverfront loft in heart of denver’s best neighborhood - executive rental
description: **Executive Rental (min 30-day stays)** If the Millennium Bridge is the gateway to Riverfront then the Promenade Lofts are the residences guarding the gate. Reflective of their name, the lofts are located at the end of the passageway into Commons Park.
host_about:
Scott Hemerda is a founding principal and owner of Vacation Rental Collective (VRC), offering premier vacation rentals along the Front Range, including the greater Denver metropolitan area.  As a native Coloradoan, Scott spent his childhood in Littleton, studied at Colorado State University in Fort Collins, and raised his family in Parker. His daily commute to downtown Denver led to a love of the city in addition to his established love of the surrounding suburbs and mountains. Scott worked in financial services as the Director of Institutional Relationships for 18 years at TIAA-CREF, where he managed relationships worth 20 billion in assets. In addition to leading the top performing relationship management team, Scott supported and retained clients through challenging service model and system changes all evidence of his superior relationship management skills.
Scott married his high school sweetheart and they have three children. A lover of sports, he instilled the values of collaboration, teamwork, and good sportsmanship as a role model participating in softball and basketball and then as a coach for all of his children in their numerous activities. Scott grew up skiing and now enjoys hiking and exploring the mountains with his wife. Business trips, family vacations, and romantic getaways have cultivated his love and expertise on the needs of vacationers.

name: Modern Cowboy 2 Bedroom Lux Capitol Hill Apartment
description:
Saddle Up! Modern Cowboy Two Bedroom Luxury Capitol Hill Apartment is your perfect pit stop in Denver. Centrally located next to Denver's world famous museums, convention center, and restaurants/bars. No detail was overlooked in this newly remodeled, aesthetically pleasing, and very comfortable apartment. Find yourself at home, and in style, to make your stay extra special. There is also ample parking in back for your horses ;)

LICENSE NUMBER 2017-BFN-0000650
host_about: Hello, I'm originally from Ohio, and I thrive on Midwestern kindness and generosity. I have three young children, but in my free time (haha), I renovate spaces into places I would love to live. Interior design + traveling are two of my main passions. Before children, I was an avid traveler and explorer. One of my favorite ways to travel was to immerse myself in the culture. Staying at an apartment, vs a hotel, allows one to feel like they live in the new spot. I hope you enjoy staying at my listings.

name: Aunt El's Haven
description: Welcome to my home in the heart of the city.  Your space is a renovated basement apt., in my home, which includes; living room with cable TV.  Bedroom #! with queen bed.  Bedroom #2 with a daybed with pop-up trundle unit.  One full bath, which is located off the smaller bedroom, access is thru that bedroom.    Kitchenette, pub table with stools.   Sliding door with lock @ foot of stairs leading into the apartment. Shared backdoor entrance with coded lock.  Close to everything Denver.
neighborhood_overview: Relatively quiet neighborhood in North City Park.   There is a grocery store, barbershop, and liquor store in close proximity to my home.
amenities: 36 inch HDTV with Amazon Prime Video, Disney+, Fire TV, HBO Max, Hulu, Netflix, DVD player
host_about:
After many, many years in the nursing field, I finally retired,YEAH!!!!!  I thought I would chill for awhile, but, I've been babysitting my great, great nieces.  They're soooo much fun.
I enjoy water aerobics, tai chi, and yoga, although I'm not so great @ those last two activities.  Family and reading are my passsions.  I love meeting new people from all cultures and backgrounds.

name: Eclectic Platt Park ~1 mile to DU & Hospitals
description:
Welcome to our very comfortable suite with private bath in our Platt Park home. Hosts have hospitality backgrounds; one is multi-lingual: English, French, German, Dutch & Spanish. House is across the street from a park/library & two blocks to S. Pearl Street.
DU (~ 1 mile away & 1 stop south) is accessible by light rail (about six blocks away). The University of Colorado Denver and Denver International Airport can be reached by light rail as well. The closest RTD bus stop is two blocks east.
neighborhood_overview: Very walkable and accessible to Denver's attractions.  Many restaurants (Thai, chicken, Mexican, Italian, Columbian, burgers, pizza, salads, sushi, poke, bakery, ice cream....), wine store, breweries (some with food trucks) & distilleries.  Galleries, antique stores, retail stores, and many coffee/tea shops sprinkle the neighborhood.  S. Pearl Street hosts a Farmers' Market every Sunday (9am - 1pm) from mid-May to mid-November.
host_about:
COVID-19 UPDATE:  ANDRÉ & NANCY HAVE BEEN VACCINATED. 
We are 5-star rated Superhosts who maintain a "sparkling clean" reputation.  That said, we have taken extra steps towards sanitizing the suite.  Every surface will be cleaned to our usual standard.  Additionally, a disinfectant will be sprayed as a finishing touch.  All bedspreads and decorative pillows have been removed and stored.  All linens, to include sheets, blankets, towels and bathmats, dish towels and drainboard mat will be machine-washed.  As I have more than one set of everything, this rotation will ensure a completely clean and sanitized stay.
For those looking to work from the suite:  we provide a high-speed gigabit internet connection for your convenience.
The beauty of having your own code for the front door is that you come and go as you please.  Andre and I maintain a very low profile, so rest-assured that you will be able to maintain your privacy.

name: Modern Baker Victorian with HOT TUB!
description: Our remodeled home in the heart of Baker/Santa Fe Art District, offers access to one of Denver's most desirable neighborhoods with abundant walkability. The neighborhood is home to great restaurants, bars, shops and is situated less than 3 miles from downtown. It offers light rail access and a neighborhood park one block away. The house is bright and inviting with lots of amenities.   The kitchen is fully stocked.  There is an amazing back yard with a HOT TUB and room for morning yoga.
neighborhood_overview:
To the east, Baker offers you Broadway with an array of bars, amazing restaurants and even it's very own movie theater, the Mayan. To the west, Baker neighbors the Santa Fe Art District with 1st Fridays you should not miss. Art galleries, shops, bars and restaurants all get together to provide an evening of fun.
Natural Grocers and Safeway are just down the road as well as quick highway access to I25 and I70.
amenities: HDTV with Amazon Prime Video, Disney+, Netflix
host_about: Born and raised in Germany to American German parents, I have spent a lot of time traveling and seeing the world and that is my true passion.  I love people, cultures and diversity in general.

name: 5 min from Coors Field includes VIP Parking!
description: Huge two bedroom loft style house featuring high ceilings, fireplace in living room, two large master bedrooms and huge gourmet kitchen. Charming back patio for chilling and grilling. Tons of restaurants and bars just steps away yet this home is secluded and quiet. Parking for 3 cars, close to Union Station, Coors Field, Broncos stadium, Convention Center and more.  HUGE BONUS if you plan to attend the game at Coors Field:  Free parking across the street from the stadium for one car!
neighborhood_overview: Lohi, Union Station, Coors Field, downtown, restaurants, parks
amenities: Free driveway parking on premises  2 spaces
Childrens books and toys for ages 0-2 years old
HDTV with Hulu, premium cable, Amazon Prime Video, standard cable, Netflix
host_about:
Hi!  A little about me... I've lived in Colorado for the last 25 years. I own and operate two companies in Denver; one is primarily real estate investing and the other is a design and commercial furnishings showroom/dealer. 
I currently am hosting my properties in Keystone, Vail, and Denver. I am blessed to be able to split my time between the city and the mountains; and also sneak in more extensive travel whenever possible. 
My hobbies include skiing, sailing, tennis, visiting art galleries, and have very recently taken up fly fishing.

name: Expansive Remodeled Basement Apartment in Capitol Hill
description:
NO CLEANING FEE!

Start your day in the big tiled shower; then catch up on emails at the handy work desk. This home reveals careful planning for two, showcased by a designer kitchenette, a washer/dryer, a smart TV with cable, a desk/workspace, and super fast Wifi.

You'll have your own private entrance to this fully remodeled apartment. And we're close to everything: a Whole Foods brand grocery store right around the corner, restaurants, bars, and Cheesman Park are close. Free street parking.
neighborhood_overview: Jog in nearby Cheesman Park and Civic Center Park, then walk just 2 blocks to cafes and restaurants for brunch. Public transportation is reliable and safe, and the bus stop is only a block from here. Stock up a grocery store just steps away.
amenities: HDTV with Amazon Prime Video, Netflix, premium cable, Disney+, standard cable, Apple TV, Hulu, HBO Max
host_about: My wife and I are Airbnb hosts so we love to explore new places and stay in other Airbnb rentals. We always try to leave the place better than we find it! As hosts, we strive to be responsive, so always text us through the Airbnb app, and we will respond as quickly as we can!

name: Modern Row Home w/rooftop in the heart of Downtown
description:
Brand new, modern row house with rooftop patio in historic Five Points, vibrant and lively RiNo, and Curtis Park neighborhood. Just minutes away from downtown. Walking distance to local coffee shops, bars and restaurants. Steps away from the Lightrail station to quickly get in to downtown or the metro area.










2020- BFN- 0002309
Lodgers ID: 302 059
neighborhood_overview: The historic Five Points neighborhood is diverse with a rich history a mile east of downtown. Numerous coffee shops, bars and restaurants within walking distance down Welton St. And 7 blocks down 30th street you will find the RiNo district with even more shops, and nightlife.
amenities: Pack n play/Travel crib - always at the listing
host_about: I am a full time Firefighter who enjoys the finer things in life such as BASE jumping, flying wingsuits with my friends and surfing. I have lived in Denver for most of my life and absolutely love it. If you have questions about the city or state, I am more than happy to answer them.

name: Beautiful SLOHI Bungalow Close to Mile High!
description: Come make yourself at home in our quiet one level, townhouse close to almost everything - Sloan's Lake, Mile High Stadium, Downtown, 32nd Street, 5 parks within a mile radius and the hopping Highlands. We have two parking spots, two desks to work from home, hardwood floors, washer/dryer, room to store bikes, granite countertops, gas stove w/ hood, and a fenced in yard with a pergola covered patio for summer cookouts. Lyft/Uber rides are minimum fare to Union Station/Coors Field/Downtown.
neighborhood_overview: Half mile a way from Sloan's Lake, 1 mile from light rail, 2 miles from Union Station and a few blocks west of Mile High Stadium, we are in a great location! Grocery store, coffee shop, 32nd St., bakery are all within walking distance.

name: The Kaleidoscope House
description: A colorful and recently updated home built in 1885 features a large relaxing front porch that is 420 friendly.  The vibrant Highlands neighborhood is coming back to life after covid and offers many great restaurants, coffee shops, brewery bars, yoga, all within walking distance.

name: Bungalow off Pearl Street
description:
Apartment/bungalow off Old South Pearl street, one of Denver's most popular neighborhoods with high walkability to restaurants, bars, coffee shops, boutique shops, light rail and bus transportation. 55" TV with Netflix and Roku, Amazon video, xfinity tv channels, Wi-Fi, kitchenette with small oven, games, etc. Make yourself at home in this lovely space and enjoy one of Denver's best neighborhoods :)
There is a queen bed and twin trundle bed.
neighborhood_overview: The house is located off Old Pearl Street, which is one of Denver's most historic, charming, and popular shopping districts in the city. Has some of the city's hottest restaurants and night life, amazing coffee shops, breweries, locally owned shops and boutiques, farmers market on Sundays (May- November) and so on. The neighborhood makes you feel like you are in a small quaint town- but yet you are 10 min car ride from downtown Denver, less than 5 min drive from DU, 10 min walking distance to light rail, close to popular Wash Park, and steps to bus transportation.
host_about: Adventurer, traveler, lover of all things Colorado.

name: Departamento acogedor 4
description: Comfortable apartment too close of downtown is available to 4 guests close of bus stop! Private entrance for the back door of the house. Totally private and you can share the kitchen if you want
neighborhood_overview: Close to downtown
host_about: I'm retired I use to work as a CPA for many years and I live in Denver from 2004

name: Capital Hill Condo in the heart of Denver
description: Our home is centrally located in the heart of Denver. Major amenities and sightseeing within walking distance include grocery stores, museums, galleries, library, restaurants, music venues and more.  There is a large private balcony, rooftop deck, sauna, basic workout room, bike storage room and laundry room.  Almost everything is within walking distance but there is also Denver B-cycle, car2go and eGo CarShare. We have topnotch AC/heating, fans, Roku TV, fully equipped kitchen and parking pass!

name: Mid-Century Modern - Close to Cherry Creek / I-25
description: Welcome! My home is a remodeled mid-century modern, open plan that is just a few minutes away from light-rail, and Cherry Creek. It's very easy to access I-25 and go either to the Tech Center or Downtown if you're driving. No matter your background, all are welcome.
neighborhood_overview: I'm sandwiched between two mid-century modern housing developments. To the north is "Krisana Park"... A mid-century enclave that is fondly referred to as "Leichler" since it thinks it is "like Eichler". To the east is "Lynwood"... Very similar houses and very much in demand. This house was built in 1958 and is one of a kind. Other stuff? We have an authentic french bakery two blocks away (Detour) as well as an independent coffee house: Sojourners.  The bus route begins a block away. The Lightrail "Colorado Station" is a mile's walk and can take you either south to the Tech Center, east to DIA or north to Downtown Denver. Cherry Creek is about 10 mins by car and has great shopping, restaurants and movie theaters. If you love gourmet, niche pizza, we have a fantastic neighborhood bistro, "Esters" that opened about a year ago. Their nachos are mouth-watering. They have a few awesome salads, some sandwiches and of course, what most people go for... The pizza (and the craft beers). Think ar
host_about: I've lived in the USA for 30+ years after narrowly escaping a rainy future in England. I can discuss American politics but not English ones, unless you count the politics of the school playground. I love chess. I've won one lottery (although there was no cash involved, just an elusive Green Card). I play six-degrees-of-separation for fun and find that in Denver, it's usually only two or three degrees (even if it's the President or a Hollywood movie star and sometimes it's one and the same). I am completely in love with my dog, Bodhi (a non-shedding, Portuguese Water Dog), who lives up to his name in every way (a being of wisdom and enlightenment). I am bummed (how's that for eloquence) that neither DaVinci or Einstein are still anchored to Terra Firma because I'd love to meet them, sit around a fountain somewhere (hopefully with an Americano in hand) and ask them what their take is on "Life, The Universe and Everything"... (Thank you Douglas Adams.) I love "Game of Thrones", "Homeland" and all things "Shameless"... And I'm just a little obsessed with the whole mid-century modern thing.

name: Tranquil Urban Retreat in Congress Park
description:
Brew up some coffee in a kitchenette with an exposed brick wall and dark granite counters. Read a book on a comfy, premium sectional sofa in a living area with a decorative brick fireplace and calm decor within this stylishly decorated and cozy apartment. All the convenience and excitement of the city, with a small-town feel. Close to Denver sights, parks, bars and restaurants, yet on a quiet tree-lined street -- the best of both worlds!

Front door keyless entry and self check-in to apartment.
neighborhood_overview: Set in the historic residential neighborhood of Congress Park, this apartment is blocks away from great dining and shopping. It’s walking distance from the Denver Museum of Nature and Science and the Zoo within City Park, as well as Congress Park, the neighborhood's namesake, Cheesman Park, and many fantastic dining and bar options.
amenities: 55 inch HDTV with standard cable, Amazon Prime Video, HBO Max, Netflix, premium cable
host_about: Hi, we are Liz and Yosef! We are a married couple who loves to travel, experience new things and enjoy life. We've had great experiences with Airbnb while traveling, so we want you to have an awesome time while staying at our home! We’d love to host you!

License 2019-BFN-0011858

Amazing Denver University location. We are half a block to restaurants and one block to the University. Three blocks to light rail. Washington park is a half mile easy beautiful walk! There is the DU gym (Olympic size
Pool and full recreation center with all types of workout classes including yoga!) that provides daily/weekly use for a guest fee.

One daughter graduated from Carleton College, another daughter graduated from Harvard, and our son is attending Carleton College. My husband is an architect. We also have a place on Nantucket, MA and Jackson Hole, Wy too, if you are interested in renting there!

I travel often for work - between Seattle/Nashville/Avon/Denver. My small pup Yuki is usually with me!

Cuddle up with cozy blankets on the couch while you enjoy a spacious, airy, open and contemporary townhouse in a fantastic location 5 minutes from downtown Denver by car. I earn my living in real estate, but I'm an artist and adventurer at heart. I love the feeling of infinity when I'm in the mountains and the landscape goes on forever.  Skiing is one of my favorite activities.  I wasn't born in the mountains, but I should have been! 

Fully vaccinated!!

name: Private Basement Suite - the Heart of Central Park
description:
If you’re looking for quiet time or conversation, you’ll find it. Many of our guests have become family. Some simply want a place to crash! We’ll be good to you no matter what.

You have your own bedroom, bathroom, family room, coffee maker, and mini fridge. Hang out and stream Netflix or head to Puddle Jumper Pool, the Stanley Marketplace, the Town Center, or downtown Denver. Easy parking and access to Stapleton and hospitals. Close to Dick’s Sporting Goods Park.



License 2021-BFN-0008898
neighborhood_overview:
Stapleton is about 5 miles from downtown and Cherry Creek. We are a community with many families, parks, schools, and restaurants. Our neighbors are like family! Feel free to ask anyone for help or suggestions.

If you are looking for restaurants and shopping in the area, check out the Stanley Marketplace. You can walk! Plenty of restaurants, retail, coffee shops, ice cream, etc. I recommend using Yelp to determine quality of restaurant and proximity.
host_about:
Scott and I bonded over many things - one is our passion for travel. It’s in the DNA of our relationship. COVID may have blocked some of our adventures - like it has for everyone - AND it’s definitely granted us new ones!

We love being hosts. We love meeting new people, talking, and not talking. We value the inclusion, sharing, and connected culture that Airbnb offers. 

It reminds me of my great grandmother taking on “boarders!!” They seemed to be where her life stories came from.

name: De La Sol—Dwell Magazine Eco Home in LoHi
description: Featured in Dwell Magazine! Enjoy a modern, luxe, eco-conscious home in LoHi, one of Denver’s most interesting neighborhoods with the ability to walk to restaurants, coffee shops, and bars.
neighborhood_overview:
The Lower Highland neighborhood is only a short bike ride to downtown, and is growing quickly. That means there are many attractive dining and shopping options within walking distance of this home.
Our home is located within a neighborhood, so we do ask guests politely respect that fact by ensuring music and voices are kept low after 10pm when outside.
host_about: I grew up in the foothills of Colorado. After living in other places for many years I decided to come back and make Denver my home.

name: Sparkling Carriage House near Downtown and Rino
description:
We pride ourselves on keeping the cleanest Airbnb in Denver. Don't be fooled by dingy hotels or Airbnb units hosted by management companies that only care about the bottom line. Amy and I meticulously clean the unit ourselves after each booking and guarantee our guests a comfortable stay. You will not be disappointed.

Guest will have full access to the carriage house except for the garage space.

As little or as much as you like. We are here to make your stay enjoyable and we are always available to answer any questions and give recommendations. We are available by texts, email or message.

The apartment is in the historic Whittier neighborhood. It's less than a mile from the popular RiNo Art District which is known for its industrial street art, coffee shops, bars, restaurants, and breweries. It's a fun area with tons to do.

Walking distance to City Park and Golf Course and the Denver Zoo. Walking and biking distance to nearby neighborhood hot
neighborhood_overview: The apartment is in the historic Whittier neighborhood. It's less than a mile from the popular RiNo Art District which is known for its industrial street art, coffee shops, bars, restaurants, and breweries. It's a fun area with tons to do.
host_about:
Born and raised in Michigan but have been living in Colorado for the past 10 years. I consider myself an avid do-it-yourselfer. If I don't know how to do something, I cannot rest until I figure it out. I enjoy the outdoors, specifically camping and most recently whitewater rafting. 

When traveling, I mostly look for seclusion and try to stay away from tourist traps at all costs. I want to experience the places no one knows about and love getting tips from the local hosts when renting on AirBnB. 

When hosting, I try to give the guests as much space as possible. I love to give tips on where to go and where to dine in order to give our guests an amazing experience that they may not have had if they just looked at travel guides on the internet. So please, ask me questions! I have good advice!

name: Modern Airy Sloan's Lake Townhome (2BR/1.5BA)

neighborhood_overview:
Some quotes on Clayton from Urbanist Insider:
"All in all, Clayton rocks because of its proximity to everywhere else in Denver, without being a busy thoroughfare. Neighbors are friendly and likely to greet you as you walk down the street. Parking is always available. Sirens are not common, and most cars drive safely through the ‘hood. The disadvantage to Clayton is that it’s so darn residential. Without much to walk to, you will definitely want to consider having a car to get around. Busses come down the major streets and bikes are certainly an option -- but having your own vehicle would be preferable here. If you don’t mind the quiet, check out Clayton."

There's not much in close proximity as far as local eateries or grocery stores, but I do recommend Lucero's down the street for fab burritos and green chili, and the tamales at Tres Girasoles are also bomb.

Park Hill is on the edge of Denver's largest park -- the one with the zoo and nature and science museum in it.

neighborhood_overview: Capitol Hill is Denver's most densely populated neighborhood. It was once the home of Denver's elite and origination of Foursquare architecture in Denver. Today it consists of historic mansions, apartments and condo buildings. Because of the concentration of multi-family uses and the urban character of the neighborhood, parking is at a premium. The area is strongly influenced by the Colorado State Capitol and Downtown Denver which is adjacent to the northwest boundary of the neighborhood. Commercial uses are typically located on major arterials such as Colfax Avenue, East 8th Avenue, East 14th Avenue, East 13th Avenue, Lincoln Street and Broadway. A considerable number of mansion properties have been converted to office uses over the past several years due to zoning exemptions offered to historic structures which are zoned for residential uses.

A favorite quote of mine, by Hunter S. host_about:
I'm a single, 50-something, friendly and sociable fellow traveler.  

I lead an itinerant home office lifestyle based out of Steamboat Springs and Denver.  (I've been "social distancing" since '94 and 28K baud modems, so I know a thing or two about the now, near dominant work-from-home challenges, setup and rewards. ;) )  

Since growing up in the small town of Eastern Pennsylvania called Nazareth, (Yeah, that's me, I am "Joseph of Nazareth"! ;P ), I have ventured through all 50 United States, and dozens of countries across North America, South America, Africa and Europe.  

My zest for travel stems from experiences in my youth attending grand and exciting "Bon Voyage" and "Welcome Home" parties, and trips to the airport, all dressed up, for family members to all of these unknown and distant places, in particular, Gram's many trips back to our mother country of Austria.  

During my first international month long travels through Europe as a 17 year old, I enjoyed many a serendipitous guest house and hostel stay.  The rest is history.

As an adult, my trips range from weekend road trips to extended multi-month adventurers, for both work as a contracting AppleOS Software Engineer and/or pleasure in pursuit of athletic, cultural and educational endeavors.  

Accommodations during my travels often require an independent, work-from-home and active lifestyle considerations, something I found not to be that readily available.  

After acquiring a single family home in a mountain and ski resort town before the real estate bubble, and then several condominiums immediately after that bubble burst, I found myself in a position to setup and offer my properties and rooms in my house for that "home office" niche.

Fast forward to the internet era, and the embrace and popularity of airbnb.com and the like, I am now able to successfully manage these rental opportunities in an enjoyable and successful manner.  "Who'da thunk". this would have been possible as a youth lusting for travel?!

I take pleasure in hosting my guests' stays at either my private condominiums and rooms in my home.  It's a great way for me to feel "connected" to that itinerant lifestyle while "home'n it".  

I tend to float between these two locations to fathering my 6 year old son in Denver and/or managing rental turnovers.  

I can "hit the ground running" at any of my properties with just a suitcase and gear in tow.  You will be able to as well.

In the interest of learning about your host, some hobbies I enjoy include home improvements, vintage vespas, photography/videography, technology, cooking, brewing beer/mead and volunteering.

I could live just about anywhere, but I chose the endearing community of Steamboat Springs in the beautiful Yampa Valley and all it has to offer.  

I'm more than happy to share my local knowledge and experiences with you during your extended  stay at my house in Steamboat, or at one of my other properties in Denver and Phoenix.

The property is located in one of the oldest neighborhoods in Denver - at edges of the Curtis Park, San Rafael and Clements Historic Districts - all of which are dominated by beautifully restored Victorian 1880's homes.

Clements Historic District typifies high-style Queen Anne and Italianate architecture, and is one of the most intact collections of late 19th Century Victorian high-style residential architecture in Denver. It is representative of the City’s rapid growth and middle class population of the 19th Century. The district maintains beautiful views of the Rocky Mountains to the west.

Curtis Park, Denver’s first street car suburb, is one of the city’s oldest and most diverse residential areas. The neighborhood’s heyday was from the late 1870s until 1893. The district is a showcase of architectural styles from that era, including Italianate, Eastlake, Queen Anne, and Victorian eclectic homes. Romanesque, French Second Empire and Gothic Revival buildings

Located less than a 5 minute walk to Tennyson St. with local boutique shops, restaurants, bars, coffee shops, breweries, yoga studio and music venues. There are 3 grocery stores within walking distance and downtown Denver is 3.5 miles away and can be reached by an easy bike, bus, Uber or Lyft ride.

Berkeley is one of Denver’s most historic neighborhoods. With a mix of century-old homes, a thriving arts district, several of Denver’s best restaurants, laid-back neighborhood bars, and unique, locally-owned shops, Berkeley has a culture all its own. Here are the neighborhood’s best spots to explore, most within a 10-minute walking distance of the Airbnb.

name: *Cannabis friendly, Private, Great Location/Value*
description: This spacious apartment has plenty of room for 2 guests to relax comfortably. You will have a private entrance, full private bathroom, bedroom with queen size memory foam mattress, comfy full size pullout sofa bed, and a kitchen with a full size refrigerator/freezer and stove/oven. Skylights in the bathroom, bedroom (light sensitive guests might consider a sleep mask) and kitchen provide the space with natural lighting during the day. You will also have access to a private backyard/patio area.
neighborhood_overview: Quiet neighborhood on the west side of town. Mostly young adults and elderly home owners... not very many kids running around. Not too much foot traffic in general and plenty of street parking. There is also a variety of delicious food options nearby! There is a pharmacy, package store, and dispensary a few blocks away. You can get an $10 Lyft or Uber ride into the downtown area very easily at any time of day or night. If you plan on doing some adventuring into the mountains you can easily access Hwy 6 West and I-25 from here. Red Rocks is only a 20 minute drive from us! Great if you plan on seeing a show while you're in town.
host_about:
Liz and Nathan have lived and worked in Denver since 2014. Liz is a talented ceramic artist and works out of her nearby studio on various pottery designs.  All of the ceramic designs displayed in the apartment are handmade by Liz, including some of the plates and bowls you'll use! If you'd like to know more about her work, please ask! 

Nathan owns and operates a personal training business nearby, Monday - Saturday 8am - 7pm. The training space is located less than a mile from their home. Nathan does exclusively one-on-one and small group coaching for strength training and conditioning as well as sport specific training for various athletes. If you have any questions at all about that, don't hesitate to ask!

We welcome people of all creeds, nationalities, genders, and beliefs... provided you act with kindness and do not encourage hate! We will not discriminate against anyone based on the color of their skin, the place they were born, the religion they ascribe to (or don't), or who they choose to love. 
You get the idea. Be good to each other. 

Please enjoy being a guest in our home and have an awesome and unforgettable time enjoying Denver and all of the other great things Colorado has to offer!

***Our property is 420 friendly. Please familiarize yourself with local laws and ordinances regarding consumption. ***

***NO tobacco smoking inside the apartment!***

Mother Nature needs our help. DO NOT LITTER. If you head into the mountains, remember to "pack it in and pack it out" and follow "leave no trace" principles. Stay up to date on FIRE BANS. Don't burn our state down, FFS!
Don't feed the Bears, and remember to have a great adventure!

name: Baker Carriage House- Amazing Location!
description:
Have your own space in Denver's hippest new neighborhood. Right out your back door are coffee shops, boutiques, mixology bars, amazing restaurants and buses to nearby downtown Denver.

We have recently added an Eero internet extender to get super fast internet speeds to the Carriage House.
neighborhood_overview: The Urbanist Magazine described the Baker neighborhood as Denver's hippest new neighborhood.  You are steps away from Illegal Pete's which serves the freshest burritos and fish tacos.  Within a couple of blocks there are coffee shops, bookstores, delicious breakfast and hip bars.  In the other direction, there are two grocery stores (Safeway and Natural Grocers).  We are right on a bus line that can take you downtown in minutes as well as anywhere else you'd like to go in Denver!
host_about: We are a social couple in our fourties with twin boys.  We enjoy cooking, having a glass of wine on the shady back porch, or going out downtown.  We are very active and love to ski, fly fish, hike, camp, bike among other things.  I also love to knit, sew and create things while my husband is also very handy and is always coming up with projects.  We both love to travel and are the types who like to ride on the cheap, slow, local buses.  We like to wander and get lost.

name: Perfect space for groups in the heart of LoHi!
description:
Prime location and welcoming space that's perfect for groups. Modern, comfortable home with open space for gathering and multiple levels for sleeping & privacy. Newly renovated with all the amenities.

Conveniently located in the heart of LoHi. Walkable to all stadiums, downtown and the best restaurants, beer and bars in Denver— minutes to RiNo/LoDo/pretty much anywhere in the city. Private parking + easy access to all highways makes getting around a breeze. Cannabis friendly.
neighborhood_overview: Walkable to just about everything Denver has to offer: downtown, city parks, Broncos, Rockies and Avs games. LoHi is one of Denver's hottest neighborhoods, for good reason. Home to top rated restaurants (Cart Driver, Bar Dough, Uncle, Senor Bear, Ash'Kara, El Five, Linger, Dimestore Delibar, Mizu, Felix, Bar Taco, Avanti and The Bindery), bars (Happy Camper, Williams & Graham, Highland Tap & Burger, Recess Beer Garden, The Occidental, Forest Room 5, Lady Jane and more), Little Man ice cream and dispensaries (Good Chemistry, Native Roots, Simply Pure).
host_about: Hi, I’m Stephanie and I’ve been delivering a 5-star experience to my guests since 2018. I've been living in LoHi for more than 7 years, and am happy to share my favorite spots around the neighborhood.  I am a frequent airbnb renter and I know what makes for a great vacation rental experience. I’ve paid close attention to the details and amenities to ensure you’re as comfortable as I want to be when I’m traveling!

Great for business travelers, friends, and families. Immaculately clean with a positive energy for all who enter. Artwork from Southeast Asia. Formal glass dining table, 75” TV. Centrally located and easy access all around Denver. Just a few minutes walk to public transit, lively Old South Pearl Street district's shops and restaurants, and all that eclectic South Broadway (SOBO) offers!
neighborhood_overview: We live in the heart of historic Platt Park, a tree-lined neighborhood within walking distance of many fine restaurants, coffee & tea shops, craft breweries, distilleries, boutiques, a library, and four great parks. Just a few minutes walk to the vibrant Old South Pearl street district and one block from the park!
host_about: Hi, I'm Kerry (She/Her). My husband, Ray (He/Him), and I are a couple that love to travel, experience new cultures, and meet new friends.

name: Guest Suite in Sunnyside, Self Check-In!
description:
Save some money on lodging and still be a quick Lyft, Uber, or scooter ride from all Denver has to offer!

Garden-level guest suite in the Sunnyside neighborhood. Entry leads down to memory foam beds, a living/dining space, laundry area, and full kitchen. Easy access to the highway; walkable to local restaurants, coffee shops, and bars; and a short ride downtown (5-10 min from RiNo, LoHi, and LoDo)

A corgi, my partner, and I live upstairs, but the downstairs guest area all yours and pet-free.
neighborhood_overview:
The guest suite is in a residential area near downtown, but you are still close to all the fun! You're minutes away to LoHi, RiNo, LoDo, Tennyson, and the National Western complex by car. You're also in scooter distance from anywhere in the downtown core, which is my favorite way to get home.

In Sunnyside you'll find brick craftsmans and bungalows intermixed with the booming housing development. The folks on my street are really friendly and always happy to chat if you happen to see one.

You're a 10-15 minute walk away from multiple coffee shops (Huckleberry, Radiator, Cherry Bean). A Nintendo 64 bar (Monkey Barrel) is a couple blocks away, which also leads to some awesome brunch spots. There are a couple breweries (Crooked Stave, Altitude are easiest to walk to, and Diebolt and Waldschanke Cidery are pretty close too) Sunny's and Bacon Social House are my favorites for food! There's an incredible ramen shop (Ramen Star) as well. There's a few boutique shops at C
amenities: Free driveway parking on premises  1 space

host_about: I'm an engineer by trade, but personality wise I am far from the stereotype. Typically when using AirBnB it's for me to find a decent place to stay so I can have more funds to travel and experience new locales.  I'm clean and respectful, and rarely spend time in an AirBnb outside of sleeping and showering.  I'm easy to get along with, and mostly am looking for a place to store my things as I explore new cities.

name: Shared Room - 1 twin bed in 12 bunk bed co-ed dorm
description: Get ready to kick back and enjoy the fanciest shmanciest retro hostel experience of a lifetime in our 9,000 sq foot mansion! Our five-star bunks include pillow-top mattresses, plush king-size pillows, and in-bed outlets/lights/storage/privacy curtains.  If you have more than one guest, you need to make a separate reservation.
neighborhood_overview: Our hostel is located in Cap Hill just a short walk from the state capitol, downtown bars and an awesome music scene. Capitol Hill was once the home of Denver’s elite and today consists of historic mansions, such as ours. The neighborhood has urban character, eclectic architecture and is well known as a haven for young artists, musicians, and bohemians (like Jack Kerouac who lived at the Colburn Hotel just one block from Ember Hostel). Near us is Colfax Avenue, which the concert and live music hub of Denver! The Filmore Auditorium, The Ogden Theater, as well as numerous late-night bars, coffee shops, thrift stores and restaurants are just blocks away. The Denver Art Museum, Santa Fe Arts District, and South Broadway bar scene is also walking distance from the hostel.

This designer four bedroom home with killer rooftop views and a hot tub is located conveniently between Denver’s Museum District, the Colorado Convention Center, and the Santa Fe Arts District, right in Denver’s Golden Triangle Neighborhood. Almost everything you could need (groceries, bars, art, restaurants, the convention center, museums) is within a 10 minute walk of the house.

The house also includes a two car garage, and all access is automated with coded locks.
neighborhood_overview: Golden Triangle is right in the middle of everything, yet quiet enough to get a good night's rest before a big day at the convention center or after a night on the town. We have plenty of good restaurants within a few minutes walk, and the 16th Street Mall is a 12 minute walk away, as are quirky art galleries on Santa Fe and the State Capitol building by Civic Center Park.
host_about: My name is David, and I'm a professional host who's been providing accommodations through Airbnb for nine years now. This property is exceptionally walk-able/bike-able to anything in the downtown area - Capital Hill, Convention Center, Arts District, Pepsi Center...and more! I look forward to your visit!

name: Cozy Convenient Access to Downtown and Foothills
description: The lower level of our highlands/berkeley home is all yours! Well lit with windows on all sides and private entrance through the back of the house. Walking distance to many restaurants, parks, and shopping. A few miles from downtown, a quick hop on I-70 to head to the mountains, and bikes for you to explore the neighborhood. We live upstairs with our two sons, born in 2015 and 2018. Happy to interact as much or as little as you'd like during your stay. Welcome!
neighborhood_overview: Northwest Denver is the best! We're located walking distance to Highlands square and Tennyson both with tons of shopping and dining. Even closer are a few tasty cafes and taco shops. Lots to explore on bike (we've got two you can borrow) or on foot. Downtown Denver is a short drive (or 3 miles on bike) or you can catch the bus half a block from the house. We're a great jumping off spot for day trips to the mountains as we're minutes from I-70. Our block is quiet and residential with great neighbors - if you're lucky you'll be here for an alley party!
host_about: I taught 7th and 8th grade science at a public school in NYC before becoming a mother. I now spend my days raising our sons (born in 2015 and 2018), running a craft blog, and volunteering in our community. My loves include food, fun, and people. My husband and I love to travel but don't do it as often as we'd like.  When we travel we much prefer depth over breadth and enjoy feeling like we got to live somewhat as the locals do. We're flexible, laid back, and up for anything! For our guests - we hope that a stay at our home is relaxing and easy. We're happy to be helpful with local tips or just stay out of your hair. We love hosting through Airbnb because it gives us a little extra cash to explore which usually gets paid forward to other hosts!

Stay in the treetops in this beautiful, light and sunny vintage top-floor apartment. Sip your morning coffee or tea in peace and quiet on the large private deck.

Location, Location, Location!

The space is perfect for traveling nurses or anyone with short-term assignments who want to be close to the city but in a quiet, centrally-located, very walkable neighborhood, close to large parks and the Botanic Gardens. Quiet, private and charming!
neighborhood_overview:
You can’t beat the location! Awesome shops and restaurants within walking distance on all sides and centrally located to virtually all of Denver’s main attractions. You can even walk the to the beautiful Botanic gardens just four blocks away for an evening of summer music, or go for a jog in nearby Chessman or City Park.

This place is close to everything! Walkable restaurants, bars and coffee shops in all directions. The brand new Carla Madison Rec center is three blocks away. Chessman Park and City Parks are only a few blocks away. The awesome Tattered Cover bookstore close-by makes a great place to spend a rainy afternoon. Or culture yourself with wine and o’dourves at Sie Film Center down the street. Uber downtown for less than $10 or head south to Cherry Creek North just a mile away!

It is also walkable to the 16th Street Mall, which has a free Mall Ride bus for transportation. There are also many electric scooters in the neighborhood, making it easier to get around.

My name is Mike, and I've lived in Denver for almost 20 years. It's an amazing city and has a growing restaurant/bar, brewery and music scene, which is great.  I work downtown close to my apartment, and regularly head up to the mountains to enjoy skiing, hiking and camping. 
I love going to concerts around town, and regularly hit up JAX Fish House for amazing oysters and beer. I'm also an avid traveler, and I'm always looking for travel destination recommendations. Share if you have a favorite place to visit.

name: Lovely 3 bed 3 bath Central Park home with garage.
description:
Great Stapleton location. New 3 bedroom 2.5 bath town home with attached garage.

Two blocks to the large Central Park with miles of walking biking trails.
Close to Childrens, VA and University of Colorado hospitals.

neighborhood_overview:

RiNo (The River North Art District)... "where art is made"... goes by the nickname of "RiNo" and has even adopted a rhino design for its official logo, so look for creative rhinos in art and signage all around the neighborhood! The district's interesting blend of urban charm and unique industrial revival makes it a great destination for visitors. Historic warehouses and factories now house jazz bars, restaurants, brewpubs, art galleries and working studios. RiNo boasts a diverse mix of creative businesses ranging from visual artists, designers and furniture makers, to craft distillers and brewers, winemakers, creators of unique outdoor gear and small-batch coffee roasters. The art definitely extends beyond gallery
