name: Stay @ The "ARTBNB" One Of Denver's Coolest Homes!
description: The Artbnb is a one of a kind place to stay. Decorated with a collection of beautiful artwork and unique furniture, you are sure to feel at home during you time here. The house is smack in the middle of Uptown/City Park West Neighborhood in Denver and is a short walk, bike or car ride to all Denver has to offer.  Four  blocks away is 17th ave - Denver's  "restaurant row" which has many of Denver Local's favorite places to eat and drink. Come stay at the Artbnb and enjoy the Mile High lifestyle!
neighborhood_overview:
City Park West/Uptown has become one of Denver's most desirable places to live due to its easy access to City Park (Denver's Largest Park) and proximity to Downtown. On the grounds of City Park are the Denver Zoo, tennis courts, bike trails, and Denver Museum of Nature & Science. Along 17th Avenue are a number of Denver's best restaurants and bars, and many have now opened along Colfax Avenue just 2 blocks south from 17th Ave.
For Breakfast in the 'hood go to...
One Fold (4 blocks away), Syrup (6 blocks away), Petes Kitchen, Rosenberg's Bagels, or there is an Einstein bagels/Starbucks three blocks away on 18th and Franklin.
For Grub in the 'hood go to...
Stubens, Ace, Park Burger, and Avenue Grill are all on 17th Avenue, Sliceworks on Colfax is the best closest pizza, Shish Kabob Grill on Colfax has the best Hummus in Denver and great food. Pinche Tacos is on York and Okinawa is great sushi close by on Colfax.
host_about: My name is Conor I am from Denver, CO. I run a construction company and love making houses beautiful. I also collect art, most being abstract paintings, they decorate my home and an airbnb rental called the "Artbnb".

name: Spacious Artist’s House in the middle of Denver
description: Fantastic, one of a kind 138 year old home with 2,550 spacious sf close to the best Central Denver has to offer. One block from the light rail or a short walk to Coors Field, the convention center, restaurants, music venues, RiNo (River North Arts District) and much more. Play cards and shuffleboard in the basement speakeasy/3rd bedroom or hang out around the fire pit out back while grilling with views of the city.
neighborhood_overview:
Just three blocks away is the River North Arts District (RiNo) which made Food + Wine Magazine's 2018 Top 10 Coolest Neighborhoods. There you'll find hundreds of great murals, coffee shops, restaurants galore, nightlife and the largest concentration of Brewery's, Cideries, Distilleries and Wineries in a 1 square mile radius anywhere in the country with 18 Breweries and counting. If you'd like to venture a bit further, you'll be a 15 minute walk from Coors Field which is surrounded by some of Denver's hottest clubs and nightlife activities. If you don't want to walk, there are scooters for rent all over. Uber and Lyft are also a great way to get around.
Also close is City Park where you'll find a golf course, Nature and Science Museum and the Denver Zoo.

name: Savor Alfresco Breakfasts at a 1920s Voyager's Garden Oasis
description:
Sink into a chocolate leather armchair & ottoman by the fireplace and soak in the open feel of a 1925 bungalow minutes from downtown. Pass through the French doors for breakfast each morning surrounded by calming, colorful plants.

Tucked between Highland Square and Sloan’s lake, we are in the midst of fabulous restaurants, boutiques, and breweries that are only steps away.

Great transit options make attractions near Denver/Boulder & the mountains of Colorado accessible without renting a car.
neighborhood_overview:
The vibrant northwest Denver neighborhood of West Highland is one of Denver’s best! Highland Square boasts wine, cheese, fish, gourmet bread and ice cream shops. Colorado is also known as the Sonoma-Napa of beer, and local breweries abound.

Within one block walking you can get to SloHi Bike & Bagel shop or Hogshead brewery where they have an array of English cask ales.

It is a 5 to 8 minute walk to Sloans lake where you can find trails for all uses and make your way to Edgewater market.
host_about: I enjoy running in every city I visit as well as Long walks! I was born in Colorado and love the outdoor experiences like skiing, trail running, cycling, and mountain climbing ! I love to travel and incorporate fabulous recipes from around the world into my daily cooking regime. I have a friendly and cuddly Bedlington Terrier who frequently travels with me. I am also an avid gardener and love to cook ‘farm to table’ as much as possible- often using my own fruit, veggies and herbs

As an active & outdoorsy Colorado native, I love being outside.  I like hanging out with good people, traveling, and drinking good beer.  I know the city well and am happy to have a dialogue with guests about how to best spend their time while in Denver and Colorado

Traveling the world and connecting with people requires a great deal of trust and natural regard for others, including their City, personal spaces and places. Airbnb is built on this idea, and it's the very reason I love to host!

Driveway parking, Smart Lock entry, and fast wifi make your stay stress-free.

neighborhood_overview: The West Colfax neighborhood is changing with the redevelopment of the former St. Anthony Hospital just three blocks away and the opening of the West line of the Light Rail system. These have brought new restaurants, brewpubs, services, and people to West Colfax. Exciting times and the character of the neighborhood continues to grow with that. Sloans Lake just three blocks away is hub for people getting outdoors and recreating.

host_about:
Thanks for staying with me! My kids flew the coop and now I enjoy opening my home to fellow travelers from across the world who are here to explore all that Denver and Colorado offer from a vibrant city to the great outdoors.

I'm happy to provide recommendations for "my" Denver and Colorado or leave you to your own time and adventures.  

As a Colorado enthusiast, I bike, hike, run, and ski as well as explore the quickly changing city and state. I love ethnic food and particularly Thai and Vietnamese.  In the last several years I've traveled to SE Asia, Paris/Amsterdam, Munich for Oktoberfest, surfing in Costa Rica as well as visiting North Dakota, the last of the 48 states for me. In July 2021 I was thrilled to visit Alaska with my family for my 50th state! So many more places to explore!

host_about:
Hi!  I'm a 5th generation Denver native with roots and pride in my place.  I love welcoming people to the Mile High City and putting our best foot forward by hosting my home.  In July 2020 I also become owner and proprietor of a very cool property in Western Colorado currently hosting three tiny homes.

Before COVID I spent several long stretches of the year working as a Tour Director.  I lead small groups on wonderful vacations like "Italy's Great Cities," or the "Best of Spain." I also lead student groups to DC and NYC, and birthright tours to Israel.

Long term travel is in my system.  I've spent years at a time in Morocco for the US Peace Corps and more years in each of Japan, Israel and Costa Rica working mostly as an English teacher and basketball coach.

Between the really long living abroad situations, I tried to see as much as I could see.  From the top bunk of a crowded boxcar on the Trans-Siberian Railway, to five-star hotels in Jerusalem I stayed everywhere.  Seeing the best and worst of accommodations, I learned to love the hospitality game.  

In 2014 I returned to Denver to became a family caregiver.  I began hosting a small family owned condo in Denver.  That little condo kept my pockets jingling and my mind spinning for four years.  So many problems!  Floods and bugs and drugs, Oh my!

But I worked that little listing, and I leveraged my hard-knock education into SuperHost status.  When it came time to trade up, I sold the condo and found this wonderful house in Denver.  I selected it specifically because I recognized its versatility as an AirBnB property.  

This home will forever be a work in progress.  It will never be perfect.  But it may be perfect for you!  I am an individual home owner and not a large conglomerate or property management company.  I'm working to improve and integrate new technology including dynamic pricing, limited automated messaging, and streamlining all my cleaning processes.

Would love to have you see these little passion projects of mine.  Speak to you soon!

neighborhood_overview:
The house is on the popular “South Broadway” which hosts a ton of restaurants, bars, breweries, dispensary’s, and liquor stores all within walking distance. Awesome neighborhood with a TON to offer.

LOCALS KNOW:
Denver’s South Broadway neighborhood, affectionately known as SoBo, has grown from a major artery into downtown to an eclectic and funky mix of taverns, clothing stores, unique eateries, bookstores and hip, live music venues with rainbow crosswalks and dedicated bike lanes. From craft breweries, distilleries and cideries to sundrenched, rooftop patios, South Broadway thrives on the unique energy of its residents and visitors.

Home to Antique Row, South Broadway is not only a destination for pieces from the 17th century, but also for immersive art experiences at vibrant, independent galleries. Check out Turn of the Century Antiques for dolls and toys and Spectra Art Space for contemporary art pieces in a fun, welcoming environment.

COOL

A gorgeous private garden patio backyard is dreamy for entertaining with market lights and hurricane candles. It has beautiful citrus and succulents and a grapevine arbor lounge area with a BBQ.
neighborhood_overview:
Highlands is a fun historic neighborhood, and one of the most walkable. You can easily walk up the alley to 32nd Ave where you’ll find NOVO coffee, El Camino tavern for authentic Colorado Mexican food and great margaritas, FnG restaurant for delicious sliders and burgers, mondo vino wine store for a superlative wine and special Colorado distilled spirits and brews, and Salt & Grinder for perfect sandwiches to take on hike. The Perfect Petal is our floral and retail boutique. You should find fun homewares and cards. Next door is Ruby Jane for all your travel apparel shopping needs!

The next neighborhood over is called LOHI. (Lower Highlands) there you’ll find incredible restaurants and views of the city. We love Bar Dough, Uncle, señor Bear, Old Major, El Five, Linger, Family Jones and Root Down. I would take a short LYFT rather than walk but it depends on your fitness level.

RINO is close and is THE hot area right now. Look for all of the art murals along Lari

Hi, We are Evan & Brad. We are active guys who enjoy all that Colorado has to offer, hiking, camping, skiing and snowboarding, concerts and exploring all the restaurants in Denver. We have 3 very friendly dogs, 2 Golden Retrievers and a Labradoodle. We love to travel both within the US and Internationally. 
We enjoy meeting new people and are happy to get to know our guest and give  advice on what to do in Denver etc.

name: Private Apartment in Gardener's Cottage-NW Denver
description: This place has it all in a charming and walk-able neighborhood. Easy access to downtown,  Regis University, I-70 and the mountains, and walking distance to Tennyson St. breweries, restaurants, coffee shops, bars and more. There is a grocery store, a liquor store and three parks within walking distance. Enjoy the small town feel of a neighborhood with every amenity you could want while having quick and easy access to Denver’s downtown, sports stadiums and the historic Highlands neighborhood.
neighborhood_overview: We love our neighborhood and the many interesting small businesses and restaurants that make it unique. You will find almost anything you need is within walking distance including a  bus line that goes straight downtown, a grocery store, liquor store and all kinds of bars and restaurants. Want to cozy up with a book at coffee shop or bookstore? We've got that. Is a micro-brew bar crawl more your style? There are four breweries within less than a mile and more a little further afield. Looking for live music? Check out The Oriental Theater, Tennyson Tap or other bars.  Want a drop-in Yoga class or other work out? We've got you covered. All of this is nearby, yet our street is nice and quiet at night; it's the best of all worlds.
host_about:
Gardening and travelling are my favorite hobbies. My husband and I are both teachers and spend our summers travelling or working in the garden and fixing up our almost 100 year old cottage. We obsess over the World Cup, love exploring local food and culture wherever we travel, and try to get away to the Rocky Mountains as much as possible. 

We are very comfortable giving guests or hosts as much quiet and privacy as they  prefer, but also enjoy chatting about local favorites and travel ideas.

When the weather is nice, golf is my favorite past time. Of course now that I'm living in Denver, most winter weekends you can find me at one of our world class ski resorts.

Located in desirable Sunnyside area in North Denver, it's a quick car/bike/scooter ride to Downtown Denver, Mile High, Coors Field, Pepsi Center. Walking distance to amazing restaurants and bars. Features 1 large bedroom with an attached second bedroom area separated by a curtain; full bath, kitchenette and ample dining/living/work space.
neighborhood_overview:
Adjacent to the popular Highlands neighborhoods of Denver, Sunnyside has its own, somewhat rustic charm, that sets it apart.

The Sunnyside neighborhood is an historic area in Northwest Denver. It's a quick commute to DIA, Boulder and downtown Denver. Our rental is located in the Southwest corner of Sunnyside, just across the street from the well-known Highlands neighborhood. Just within a 1-mile radius are beautiful parks, craft breweries, unique ice cream shops, amazing restaurants and boutique shopping. Most major event centers are less than 10 minutes away.

host_about:
I love working outside in the garden - it's pretty obvious when you see my yard. I love it so much, I turned it into a business. I'm also a graphic designer, which I do on a freelance basis.  I don't love the cold of winter but I deal with it because I love living in Colorado and I'm an avid skier. We also just became parents in December of 2018 so we are adjusting to parent life and spending more time at home :-)

Boutiques, wine shops and bookstores, as well as popular restaurants and bars radiate out from Highland Square on West 32nd Avenue and Lowell Boulevard. And, in the Tennyson Street Cultural District, you can spend an afternoon browsing antique prints, photographs and paintings from Colorado artists, plus find live music venues and great ethnic foods. neighborhood_overview:
A few years ago, a trip to Sloan’s Lake was all about the water: fishing the marina, paddling the scenic shoreline, and, of course, enjoying the famed Dragon Boat Festival. Today, the lake isn’t the neighborhood’s only attraction, thanks to a slew of cultural additions. Shops and restaurants have turned part of West 29th Avenue into a walkable strip, while developments like the Lakehouse condo community on the former site of St. Anthony’s Hospital are transforming the area near West Colfax. All you’ll need to enjoy the neighborhood are some comfy shoes and an empty stomach.

A construction boom has also characterized the Sloan's Lake neighborhood in recent years, with a flurry of both single-family homes and apartment units being built. Houses range from historical Victorian home plans to cozy bungalows, contemporary duplexes, and modern condos giving Sloan’s Lake residents an eclectic neighborhood drive and homes for all tastes.

Valid CC or Debit Card Required for check in for incidentals/proof of identity but will not be charged.
neighborhood_overview: We are in the HEART of downtown Denver and walking distance to major Denver attractions. Hostel Fish is steps from Coors Field, minutes from the trendy RiNo district, and surrounded by cool bars. PROTIP: There's an incredible axe throwing place across the street!
host_about: We the People of Hostel Fish believe that a hostel of backpackers, by backpackers, and for backpackers, shall be a fun, safe, spotless, high-end joint that is Classy as F…(ish!). We are focused on the traveler and the traveler's needs and believe something being affordable should still offer exemplary service and more than expected perks. We believe that shared rooms and neo-urbanism, when combined, create an epicenter for those "seekers of life's adventures" to meet each other and foster new friendships. We're stoked to host you. We're jazzed to have you as our guest. We're here for you and always want to hear your thoughts or suggestions on how we can improve your experience.

name: Cozy Entire Basement Level Apartment
description:
Welcome to our charming basement apartment in the historic Cap Hill area of Denver! Whether you're here to explore the city's cultural landmarks or indulge in its vibrant nightlife, we offer the perfect home base for your Denver adventure.

Our space is situated in a quaint neighborhood within walking distance of numerous groceries, restaurants, bars, coffee shops, & the city's most popular parks. You'll love the convenience of stepping outside and exploring all Denver has to offer.
amenities: Clothing storage: walk-in closet, closet, and wardrobe
Coffee maker: drip coffee maker, pour-over coffee
host_about: Welcome to my Airbnb! I'm a structural engineer who loves all things fitness, traveling, and nature. I truly believe that traveling can mold us and allows us a better understanding of the world around us. When I'm not working or exercising, I enjoy a nice cup of coffee, snowboarding, hiking, jazz/classical music, and spending time with my dog, Nala. Let's connect and explore! Adventure is out there!

name: Steck's Roost at Wash Park
description:
Steck's Roost at Wash Park is a cozy one bedroom retreat- only 2 blocks from Denver's popular Washington Park and minutes from excellent neighborhood restaurants and shops.

As a family owned business, we are committed to ensuring an outstanding lodging experience for our guests.

Apartment is garden level with private patio and separate entrance.
neighborhood_overview: Our home of 50 years is a brick bungalow built in 1910 and remodeled through the years. The neighborhood has seen new construction over many years and the home styles are quite eclectic, making Wash Park a very popular neighborhood to visit. There are excellent restaurants, specialty shops and businesses  within easy walking distance from the house. We are also on the cusp of downtown Denver and  renowned Cherry Creek Shopping boutiques, restaurants and stores.
amenities: Cuisinart Air Fryer Combo stainless steel oven
Pack n play/Travel crib - available upon request
Childrens books and toys for ages 0-2 years old, 2-5 years old, and 5-10 years old
host_about: We are long-time Denver residents and have lived in the same house in the popular Washington Park neighborhood of central Denver for over 40 years. Rick is a retired Denver teacher and has been a real estate broker since 1980. Betty is also retired after many years in the corporate world.   We have traveled extensively and enjoyed staying in B&B's in France, especially.  It is our hope that we can replicate that ambiance in our home. We love the area near our home because of easy access to great restaurants, walking in  the park, downtown Denver,  public transportation and to our beautiful Rocky Mountains.  We are delighted to be able to host Airbnb guests in our comfortable, one bedroom  apartment.

name: Beautiful, BIG, Bungalow! Near DT! All the Extras!
description: Enjoy this recently updated, historic, Four bed, Two bath bungalow with new furniture. Walking distance to the lively Tennyson Street or Regis University,  short Uber ride to downtown or Highlands Square. Be in the mountains in the morning (Red Rocks 17 min), and on a golf course, or downtown in the afternoon from this location. Rocky Mountain Lake Park is practically your back yard! The home is perfect for families or great for a group get away.
neighborhood_overview: Walking distance to Rocky Mountain Park, Lakeside Amusement Park and the lively Tennyson street which includes some of the most amazing restaurants, bars, and retail locations in the city. Close to downtown and Highland Square!
host_about: We are passionate about sharing the places we love with those seeking adventure.

name: Cozy Cottage Apartment in Historic Highlands
description:
Welcome to the Potter Highlands!!

We are so excited to welcome travelers to our brand new studio apartment in the heart of one of Denver's thriving historic districts.

Our private cottage style apartment was completed in late 2018 and was designed to be a comfortable, calm get away in the heart of our busy and growing city.

It is walking distance from fantastic restaurants, parks, and historical sites. It is a quick 5 minute drive (or 20 minute walk) into the heart of downtown Denver.
neighborhood_overview:
Potter Highlands is a fantastic neighborhood, and in our opinion, one of the best locations in Denver! There are numerous award winning restaurants within walking distance. The area has several parks and boutique shopping areas that are also within walking distance, or a short drive. If you are on a bike the town is your oyster and you can access numerous bike paths to get around town. We are about a 15-20 minute drive to the foothills and mountains beyond. One of our favorite weekend traditions includes a short walk to one of the best bakeries (The Wooden Spoon), a stop off at our local park and library (Highland Park and Woodbury Library), and an evening out at one of our many delicious restaurants (Root Down, Duo, etc), or a hand crafted cocktail at the local award winning speakeasy (Williams and Graham).
If you are driving, our neighborhood has abundant street parking. Uber/Lyft are fast and easy in our area, usually only taking a few minutes to arrive.

name: Denver Getaway Studio in Contemporary Rustic Style
description:
Slide back the bedroom barn doors made from Beetle Kill Pine from the Rocky Mountains set beneath an original 1909 beam and start the day in the dual-head over-sized shower. After a BBQ dinner, sit by the fire pit under the twinkling string lights. This cozy basement studio has everything you need to explore all Denver has to offer!

Get a great night's rest before heading out on your Colorado adventure! Cook meals in a fully-equipped kitchenette.
Utilize the spacious modern shower w/ dual shower heads.
Stay in to work, write that blog, cozy up to watch a movie, or read a book.

Parking is next to garage in back of house. Entrance is through back gate and backyard.

I am available as much or little as you would like to interact. I am happy to provide a local Denverite/Coloradan perspective and recommendations.

Located across the street from the Regis University Campus, this neighborhood is quiet yet bustling. Take an easy 4-minute wal
neighborhood_overview: Located across the street from the Regis University Campus, this neighborhood is quiet yet bustling. Take an easy 4-minute walk to the main street for breakfast at the bakery and cafe. Later, browse the antique store and visit the micro-brewery.
host_about:
I work as a Surgical Nurse. Besides helping people, my passion is traveling. I love to meet new people, eat, see, and do new things, be inspired by the world and others, live a healthy lifestyle, ski, run, hike, bike, swim, and do anything outdoors! 
I am first generation American, but was born in Switzerland. I grew up bilingual speaking both Swiss German and English, and Switzerland is my second home!

name: Private Spotless Denver 2 bdrm apt great location
description:
This very clean private second-floor sunny apartment in the host's home located in the Central Park (fka Stapleton) neighborhood is the perfect home-base for exploring Denver and front range with easy access to DIA and Downtown.

Exclusive private entry through the front door, two bedrooms, a great room, kitchenette, full bath; in a highly walkable neighborhood near restaurants, groceries, open space—easy parking, and a short drive to downtown Denver. NO CLEANING FEE and no intermediary company.
neighborhood_overview:
Built on the site of the original Denver airport, the Central Park (fka Stapleton) neighborhood is a walkable infilled part of the City of Denver. Within a 2 block walk is the Eastbridge Town Center with 5 different restaurants (some award-winning), and the Constellation Ice cream shop. There is also a Pilates studio and an Endorphin fitness studio in the town center. Across from the town center is the grocery (and Starbucks). You can find everything that you need, and Colorado just passed a law allowing you to buy beer at the grocery store (this is very thrilling for us locals). The store is stocking a great selection of local and national craft beers.

Just to the north is the beginning of miles of open space parkland. You can take a run or just walk and enjoy our hawks and bunnies. If you're lucky, you might spot a coyote. A short walk can take you to our municipal recreation center with a cardio room, weights, and an indoor pool.

A little farther walk or s

host_about: Hi I’m Todd (he/him).  My wife and I love traveling both in the states and internationally. We love camping, music and skiing. I have an adult son and two kids from my wife’s first marriage. I am also an Airbnb host.

name: Quaint Space - Near Downtown & Broncos Stadium
description: Whether you're in town for work, or for play, everything is just minutes away! Walk to the Broncos Stadium, Union Station, and some of Denvers best breweries, restaurants and more! This victorian home is the perfect jumping off point to explore Denver. Cozy space to come home to and relax after a long day.
neighborhood_overview: Our house is a block away from Briar Commons and Jefferson Park. We are also only a short walk to the Broncos Mile High Stadium.
amenities: Pack n play/Travel crib - available upon request
host_about: I grew up in the mountains, and have remained hooked to the outdoors. I love to ski, hike, camp and mountain bike. I'm always looking for new experiences, opportunities and places to explore. My favorite quote is by Eleanor Roosevelt, "do one thing every day that scares you."

name: Clean quiet carriage house close to lightrail
description:
Come enjoy a sanctuary in the city. Our quiet, cozy carriage house is within walking distance of the light rail, RiNo art district, restaurants and dozens of craft breweries. High speed fiber optic internet provided.

Located one mile from I-70, a trip to the mountains is within 30 minutes.

The apartment is filled with natural light and all the comforts of home. With a queen bed in the bedroom and a queen memory foam mattress on the sofa bed, four adults can comfortably stay.
neighborhood_overview:
Located two blocks from the trendy River North Arts District in the Cole neighborhood, you are close to many of Denver's best restaurants, breweries and art galleries. Proximity to two light rail stations makes travel further into the city or to Denver International Airport easy.

Our neighborhood is a great blend of the old and the new.

A new 7-11 is located one block away, Natural Grocers is 0.6 miles away, Safeway 1.3 miles away.
amenities: Pack n play/Travel crib - always at the listing

neighborhood_overview: Located right in the middle of LoHi, the hottest spot in town! You will be within walking distance of some of the best restaurants and bars (Avanti, Linger, Root Down, Williams & Graham, Little Man Ice Cream) and minutes away from all the major stadiums (Pepsi Center, Broncos Stadium, Coors Field). A quick Lyft/Uber ride will put all of Denver's hippest areas within easy reach: $6-$10 to LoDo, Uptown, & South Broadway; Cherry Creek is only about 20 minutes away. With easy access to the highway, this is perfect spot to start or end your Mountain Getaway.

description:
Take refuge from the city in this charming, eclectic 1920s bungalow. Sip your coffee next to the fireplace, or enjoy a morning walk through the tree-lined 'hood.

*Note that steep, uneven stairs lead to the extra bedroom in the basement, which also has low ceilings*

License # 2019-BFN-0010068 *NO PARTIES or PETS*

The Sunnyside neighborhood is one of Denver's best kept secrets. It is home to fun local coffee shops, boutiques and restaurants, yet still maintains a mellow neighborhood vibe.

The bungalow is 5 minutes from I-70 on ramp, 8 minutes from I-25, 10 minutes from Union Station, 8 minutes from The Mission Ballroom, 10 minutes from the Bronco's Stadium, 10 minutes from the Pepsi Center, 15 minutes from the Ellie Caulkins Theater and the rest of downtown's gems.
amenities: TV with Roku, Netflix, HBO Max, Amazon Prime Video, Hulu, Apple TV
host_about: Hello! I am a self-employed Wellness Coach, Massage Therapist and Yoga Teacher. Denver, Colorado is my home. When I travel, I usually use AirBnB, and also enjoy hosting people in my home when I'm away.  What fuels me: hiking, eating, creating, hanging with my pup, and making new friends.

name: Remodeled Highlands Home with all the Essentials
description:
Stay in one of Denver's most desirable neighborhoods - The Highlands! Walk to bars, restaurants, workout studios, parks...you won't even have to leave the area unless you want to!

AS SEEN ON TV! Proudly featured on the Emmy-nominated TV show, American Dream TV, broadcasted on Roku, Apple TV, and more streaming networks. Search "Denver Highlands - Vital Root and STRs" on YouTube for a video walkthrough.
neighborhood_overview: The highlands is known for its Victorian-era homes, quaint local businesses, and vibrant night life. Tennyson street is a few blocks away and a main hub for locals and tourists alike. Walk to 32nd street and you'll find a similar sprawl of trendy shops and chic restaurants that are quintessentially Denver.
host_about: Hello! I am a wanderer myself and to me, to travel is to live. Experiencing new places, people, cultures, food - I love it all. I'm a respectful guest who's very clean and friendly. And as a host I love to make people feel welcome and free to explore my beautiful hometown.

It was newly built for our Abuelita and Babu, and features a comfortable queen sized bed, fully equipped kitchen, wifi, smart TV, and washer and dryer. Abuelita's house is cleaned using CDC-approved cleaning products and techniques.
neighborhood_overview:
Platt Park is a super walkable neighborhood, full of restaurants, breweries, and shops. Walk out the back gate to check out our favorite brewery, Platt Park Brewery, some of Denver's tastiest ice cream at Sweet Cow, or a burger and fries at Park Burger. If you're a coffee addict like us, walk just one block north to enjoy a latte or fresh squeezed juice at Steam Espresso. If you're staying with us during the summer, the Pearl Street farmers' market runs every Sunday, featuring local produce, artisanal foods, and one-of-a-kind finds.

Need recommendations? Just ask!

Minutes to all the attractions, downtown, Coors Field, Mile High Stadium, museums, breweries, LoDo, the capital, Union Station, 16th Street Mall, Denver skate park, Sloans lake, you can literally cross over the bridge or jump on the freeway and you're there.
host_about: My name is Dina  and my husband is Jeff .  We fell into the world of vacation rentals when we bought a condo in Vail.  We never had any intentions of renting it until we got engaged.  Renting our condo helped us pay for our wedding in La Paz, Bolivia.  We love to travel the world and we think short term rentals are the best way to experience it!

Perfect for out of town parents or grand-parents who are looking for easy access to nearby parks, coffee shops, breweries, ice cream, and more.  A short distance to Denver Zoo, Science and Nature Museum, City Park, local markets, and breweries.
neighborhood_overview: Short distance to Science and Nature Museum, City Park, Grocery, Coffee, Ice Cream, Brewery, Park Hill Library, and Downtown Denver.
amenities: Coffee maker: Keurig coffee machine, pour-over coffee
host_about: Live in Denver with my wife, three daughters- 7, 5 and 8 months, and our golden retriever! We enjoy skiing, camping, paddle boarding and visiting Avalon,  New Jersey during the summer.

name: Charming University of Denver Cottage Apartment
description: This garden-level apartment oozes charm and boasts convenience. It's one block from the University of Denver and two blocks from the DU light rail stop and walking distance from Evans and Pearl St. bars, restaurants, and shops. It's a great spot if you are visiting DU, checking out the hubbub of Denver, or stopping by en route to the mountains. The apartment has a bedroom with a queen-sized bed and desk area and a living room with a working fireplace and comfy couch with pull-out queen bed.
neighborhood_overview: We are blocks from the University of Denver and DU light rail station; short walks to Platt Park Brewery and bars and great restaurants (like our favorite brunch spot, Jelly, 5 min away) on Evans St., Pearl St., and University Ave.; and a quick jaunt from the great trails at Washington Park.
amenities: TV with Amazon Prime Video, Apple TV, Hulu, Netflix
host_about: Laura and Louis here. We moved to Denver over five years ago because we wanted to live where we vacationed! We like to take advantage of the city of Denver as well as its access to the mountains, spending time at local breweries, the theater, snowshoeing, and hiking. We also like to travel quite a bit, both domestically and internationally.

name: Modern Guesthouse in Denver Highlands Neighborhood
description: Spend your nights in one of Denver's pristine neighborhoods; close to great restaurants, bars, boutiques, coffee shops, parks, and Sloane's Lake. Our newly built guest house is located in the Denver Highlands neighborhood, walking distance from 32 & Lowell and just a 5 minute ride from Denver Union Station and/or Mile High Stadium.  We are close to 5280’s trendy & hip Tennyson Square, LoHi, Uptown, Downtown, Wash Park, Pearl Street & RiNo neighborhoods.
neighborhood_overview: We are walking distance from Sloane's Lake and/or 32nd & Lowell shopping & dinning area.  We are in one of the funnest, up and coming areas in Denver.  New places to visit & explore pop up every day.

There are many local and chain restaurants, breweries and stores nearby as well as a park across the street.

Its also conveniently located near redevelopment of the old Denver Stapleton Airport with many national chain restaurants and stores.

We love anything outdoors - mountain biking, camping, canoeing and scuba diving/beach-bumming :) We're foodies- Asian, sushi, great pizza, and Mexican in particular. We are coffee fanatics - I make espresso most every day and roast the beans occasionally.  We are accomplished cooks who enjoy entertaining, and appreciate good wine. We also enjoy great music - we're regulars at the Telluride Bluegrass Festival and Red Rocks concerts and especially love live music. And we love being airbnb hosts! Because of airbnb we have met the most amazing, delightful and diverse group of people imaginable.

name: NEW! Walker's Paradise Apartment in Congress Park
description: Welcome to a newly remodeled apartment in Congress Park! This 2-bdrm, 1-bath unit is located in the window-filled basement level of a 3-story Denver Square house. The neighborhood is known for its friendly attitude, tree-lined streets, and proximity to Denver's best parks. With a walk score of 84 and a bike score of 94, this place is ideally located for getting around on foot & bike. Walk to Sprouts, Trader Joe's, coffee shops, movie theaters, ice cream parlors, local restaurants, and much more!
neighborhood_overview:
From this excellent location, you can grab an ice cream or shake at Little Man's famous new shop, Sweet Cooie's, enjoy top sushi at Sushi Ronin- one of Denver's top-rated spots - and go for a walk or run in City Park to see the Denver Skyline and mountain views. In the morning, answer emails and get a coffee, fresh juice and breakfast burrito from French Press, then head to Cherry Creek for upscale shopping and great people watching. Close the night by watching live music at the Blue Bird theatre.

This apartment also lies just blocks from Denver's best parks, museums, and the zoo. You'll be only a 5-to-10-minute bus or bike ride away from the downtown action, filled with breweries, restaurants, high-end shopping, and the 16th Street Mall.

Amazing hiking outside of Golden rests just 20 minutes away, while you're 1.5 hours to some of the best skiing in the world (Vail, Breckenridge, Copper Mountain, Arapahoe Basin, etc.).

The neighbourhood of Congress P
host_about: Originally from Saskatoon, Canada now living in Denver, USA.  I am an economic development consultant who travels a lot for work.  Hence frequent trips to other countries!  I am a major fan of snowboarding, kite surfing and ultimate frisbee.  Also exploring new places, speaking new languages (I also speak Swahili but it is not an option on Airbnb) and learning about new cultures.

name: The Sol urban homestead basement retreat
description:
Prepare to be charmed by the Sol house. This two bedroom, 1 bath basement level guest suite retreat is located in the lovely Clayton neighborhood, minutes from RINO, City Park, Whittier and Downtown. Wake up and sip on the complimentary coffee or tea in your sun filled abode. This comfortable urban oasis has all of the amenities that you need to make your visit to Denver feel like a home away from home.
1.2 miles to the start of RINO, 1.7 miles to City Park, 2 miles to Union Station.
neighborhood_overview: Set in one of Denver's oldest neighborhoods, and is minutes away from everything the city has to offer including art, culture, dining and nightlife. Clayton is also surrounded by Whittier, Cole, 5points and Rino. Within two blocks is our favorite coffee shop Rivers& Roads. Great coffee and delicious food! Clayton is a mixed income neighborhood with multiple schools. We have lived in this area of Denver for four years and adore it! Denver is a relatively safe city but we recommend like in any city, locking car doors and not walking alone at night.

Please enjoy our city’s nightlife, sporting events, festivals, and music scene! WELCOME TO DENVER!!

We are within a five minute walk to Larimer Street and the RiNo district, where you can find something unique at some boutiques, explore our artistic graffiti, coffee shops, restaurants galore, and five breweries - all within a two-block radius of each other. Check out the Denver Central Market where you can choose a little of everything.

1.5 miles from Presbyterian St. Lukes Hospital and Rocky Mountain Children's Hospital.

With in a mile; you’re in LoDo, enjoying the nightlife and club scene, taking in a ballgame at Coors Field or enjoying the stunningly remodeled Union Station.

You have kids - no problem! We have Curtis Park Playground in our backyard and other kid friendly activities such as the Denver Aquarium, Denver Zoo
amenities: 36 inch HDTV with Amazon Prime Video, Disney+, HBO Max, Netflix

There are parks, stores, restaurants, fast food places, super markets all within just a few minutes drive.

We love traveling the world and meeting other travelers.

Full kitchen and laundry.

name: Insta-Worthy Victorian Home (3 beds +balcony/loft)
description:
WELCOME TO YOUR HOME AWAY FROM HOME IN DENVER!

Discover the perfect blend of historic elegance and contemporary style in our 130-year-old Victorian condo, located in the heart of Five Points. This "Insta-worthy" 3-bedroom home offers modern amenities, accommodating up to 6 guests with 3 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms. Enjoy scenic city skyline views, a cozy west-facing balcony, two living areas, and a full array of wonderful amenities for a memorable stay in Denver.
neighborhood_overview:

neighborhood_overview:
Our home is located in historic Globeville, one of the original neighborhoods of the city, which was settled in the mid-1880s by Polish and German immigrants. In the heart of Globeville and just down the street from our home is Garden Place Elementary, built in 1904. Don't miss checking out the amazing mural artwork on this beautiful school! Globeville is a very eclectic, diverse neighborhood in the early stages of gentrification and while centrally located to downtown Denver it still resonates a "small town" feel. Walk to Globe Hall which is a Live Nation venue for live music concerts BBQ and drinks and visit Globeville's own little quirky speakeasy, Fort Greene, (they have no sign, just look for the Budweiser sign out front). Both are just blocks from our home!

Globeville is situated between the River North (RiNo) neighborhood and the Highlands and LoHi neighborhoods which are both popular areas.
The RiNo Art District is 3 minutes away and Coors Field and lower Do

description:

property_type: Private room in bed and breakfast
host_about:
Nestled in the quaint Capitol Hill Neighborhood of downtown Denver, this romantic Bed and Breakfast is a Colorado and National Historic Landmark and is just a short walk from everything in the Mile-High City, including attractions, gourmet restaurants, theaters, museums and shopping.

Built in 1891, the gorgeous ruby sandstone mansion is located on Denver’s famous “Millionaires Row,” just a block from the mansion immortalized in folklore -- the home of “Unsinkable Molly Brown.” This was Denver’s original upscale neighborhood. Eight elegantly appointed rooms and suites offer turn-of-the-century opulence with modern day flair.

name: The Mile High Escape in Curtis Park
description: The Mile High Escape in Curtis Park is the ideal getaway for travelers looking to escape in style. A lot of thought and care has been invested in creating this serene atmosphere. The windows inside of home allows it to fill with an abundance of natural light, which is convenient for all guests since Denver receives 300 days of sunshine a year.
neighborhood_overview: “RiNo,” the trendy River North Art District features contemporary art galleries and hip concert venues in revamped industrial buildings. Food halls include Denver Central Market, Improper City and The Source, a buzzy indoor venue with eclectic products and a bar for small plates and craft beer. Known for its colorful murals, Upper Larimer Street also has cocktail lounges, brewpubs with patios and late-night food trucks.

host_about: Having lived in the stunning State of Colorado since 2015,  we are excited to share our space with you so you can explore Denver and the beautiful Rocky Mountains! description: Mile High Overlook - Entire condo with amazing roof top views!
neighborhood_overview:
This townhome is situated in the Sloan's Lake area of Denver just west of the river - an unbeatable location offering convenient driving distance to a plethora of restaurants, bars, shops, and activities, plus Mile High Stadium within walking distance just across the street. Broncos fans or travelers in town to watch their home team play in the Mile High City will be delighted about this ideal proximity!

More information
Check out the Alamo Drafthouse or Sloans Tap & Burger, just a short drive away. About 1.5 miles north is the trendy Highlands neighborhood with more eateries and boutiques to discover. Downtown is about 2.5 miles away - hop on the light rail to get there, with the nearest station only about a 5-minute walk from the property! Channel your inner tourist by strolling down 16th Street Mall or grabbing a bite to eat in Larimer Square.

With Sloan's Lake just a 10-minute walk away, you'll definitely want to spend a morning or 2 lounging in the city'

Brand new everything! Gas range in fully stocked kitchen w/ dishwasher. New washer/dryer. Two new bathrooms! Wired sound throughout - use bluetooth and enjoy music in the living room or during your shower!

Walk to Tennyson or 32nd street- your perfect Denver home!

neighborhood_overview:
Too many to list! We are a 5 minute walk from all the bars/restaurants of Tennyson street and 8 minute walk from the Highlands (Lowell/32nd). We have a welcome sheet w/ all our favorites listed and will share that upon arrival (or email it ahead of time if you'd like).

The stretch between 38th and 46th avenues on Tennyson Street has developed into a dining destination all its own, with high-end eateries, casual diners, cocktail bars, and more. With the street and its surrounding neighborhood changing almost daily, it can be hard to keep up. Most recently opened are High Point Creamery and The Grateful Gnome brewery. Coming very soon are new restaurants Tres Chiles, a Mexican grill, and Wendell’s, a breakfast diner in the former home of DJ’s Berkeley Cafe. The closings are bittersweet, but many lasting businesses are still staples.

From a Dutch sandwich shop and Native American eatery to two brand new drinking destinations, here are Eater’s current favorites. The

Hundreds of guests hosted and all great reviews!  We welcome ALL with open arms. All religions, nationalities, genders.  We've recently added a Pack and Play to make my listings to be more family friendly and we have great Internet and work space for your business trips - let me know how I can make your Denver experience unforgettable!  

We love to travel and have been all around the world.  We've been hosting through Airbnb for over 7 years now and I also volunteer to host international guests in my home for a month or more at a time. description:

**A tenant lives upstairs. We only allow the outdoor grill in the backyard courtyard to be used by both tenants.**

2024-BFN-0010287
neighborhood_overview: We are located in a Prime location in downtown Denver.
host_about:
Welcome to our page! 

We are a hospitality and property management company dedicated to guest experience, fast response times, property cleanliness and an overall seamless and enjoyable stay for our guests. 

We manage everything from luxurious homes to affordable, yet value driven properties. Whether you want to explore the mountains in Colorado, soak up the sun in South Florida or look for longer term stays for business travels, our portfolio has a diverse set of properties in locations nationwide. 

Each property is fully stocked with items such as linens, kitchenware, everyday house hold items and more. Our team is constantly auditing our properties and performing quality control checks to ensure we have everything just right for your stay. Our cleaning partners dedicate themselves to thorough and detailed cleans that match the standard of 5-star hotels. 

Things do happen from time to time and when they do we are right here to answer any questions or concerns. We respond quickly and have a 24-hour response team in those rare emergencies. 

Lastly, hospitality is our number one focus. We are here to answer your questions, guide you through your stay and take care of anything you need.  We want you to have a memorable experience that keeps you choosing us for you next travel adventure!

name: Urban 1BR in the Heart of Downtown Denver
description:
Centrally located 1BR apartment in LoDo area of Denver (Lower Downtown). Walk to Union Station in 5 minutes, Whole Foods in 7 minutes, Less than 1 mile from CU Business School, Pepsi Center, and Coors field. Walk to numerous restaurants in the area.

If you want to be in the heart of Denver and enjoy city living, this place is for you!
neighborhood_overview: LoDo, Denver's oldest neighborhood, is home to some of the city’s best-known restaurants, galleries, shops and boutiques. Located in the heart of downtown, businesses ranging from finance and real estate to retail and start-ups can be found here. Whether you are here to work, play, or live, LoDo's family-friendly attractions and businesses entice visitors and locals alike, making it the country's most vibrant neighborhood.
host_about: Love traveling and spending time outdoors!

name: Bright and modern in Denver!

This duplex has quick access to I-70 and I-25 to get to the mountains, downtown, and all sporting venues. You'll love your stay in Denver!
neighborhood_overview: You'll love the restaurants (hello, brunch spots!), boutiques, and bars in close proximity to the house!

Excellent location close to highways, downtown Denver, and numerous restaurants, bars, and parks.

host_about:
I'm a single, 50-something, friendly and sociable fellow traveler.  

I lead an itinerant home office lifestyle based out of Steamboat Springs and Denver.  (I've been "social distancing" since '94 and 28K baud modems, so I know a thing or two about the now, near dominant work-from-home challenges, setup and rewards. ;) )  

Since growing up in the small town of Eastern Pennsylvania called Nazareth, (Yeah, that's me, I am "Joseph of Nazareth"! ;P ), I have ventured through all 50 United States, and dozens of countries across North America, South America, Africa and Europe.  

My zest for travel stems from experiences in my youth attending grand and exciting "Bon Voyage" and "Welcome Home" parties, and trips to the airport, all dressed up, for family members to all of these unknown and distant places, in particular, Gram's many trips back to our mother country of Austria.  

During my first international month long travels through Europe as a 17 year old, I enjoyed many a serendipitous guest house and hostel stay.  The rest is history.

As an adult, my trips range from weekend road trips to extended multi-month adventurers, for both work as a contracting AppleOS Software Engineer and/or pleasure in pursuit of athletic, cultural and educational endeavors.  

Accommodations during my travels often require an independent, work-from-home and active lifestyle considerations, something I found not to be that readily available.  

After acquiring a single family home in a mountain and ski resort town before the real estate bubble, and then several condominiums immediately after that bubble burst, I found myself in a position to setup and offer my properties and rooms in my house for that "home office" niche.

Fast forward to the internet era, and the embrace and popularity of airbnb.com and the like, I am now able to successfully manage these rental opportunities in an enjoyable and successful manner.  "Who'da thunk". this would have been possible as a youth lusting for travel?!

I take pleasure in hosting my guests' stays at either my private condominiums and rooms in my home.  It's a great way for me to feel "connected" to that itinerant lifestyle while "home'n it".  

I tend to float between these two locations to fathering my 6 year old son in Denver and/or managing rental turnovers.  

I can "hit the ground running" at any of my properties with just a suitcase and gear in tow.  You will be able to as well.

In the interest of learning about your host, some hobbies I enjoy include home improvements, vintage vespas, photography/videography, technology, cooking, brewing beer/mead and volunteering.

I could live just about anywhere, but I chose the endearing community of Steamboat Springs in the beautiful Yampa Valley and all it has to offer.  

I'm more than happy to share my local knowledge and experiences with you during your extended  stay at my house in Steamboat, or at one of my other properties in Denver and Phoenix.

neighborhood_overview: ELEGANT & HISTORIC, MONTCLAIR --  Denver's  Montclair neighborhood is lined with brick homes, tree-lined avenues, and eccentric local businesses. Montclair is the brainchild of Baron Walter von Richthofen, a Prussian aristocrat and the uncle of famed WWI German pilot "Red Baron" Manfred von Richthofen who wanted an "utopian community" built on what were at the time empty fields east of Denver.  He started in 1887 with building what is now known as the community's centerpiece, the 14,938-square-foot limestone Richthofen Castle, located at 7020 E. 12th Ave.  My husband and I feel lucky to live here in Montclair with its beautiful homes and quiet and peaceful neighborhood, but we acknowledge that our "Utopia" has to evolve to include all souls.

Hello! My name is Krista and I live in the United States with my husband and our two little boys, who are one and three. I was an early user of Airbnb and listed my first property (which was the house I lived in) in 2012. I rented that property out for seven years until I met my husband, Jeff, and then we rented our properties out together to pay for weekend getaways!

Fast forward to today --- one marriage and two kids later, Jeff and I have hosted thousands of guests in a handful of properties and have stayed at many Airbnb’s all over the world. We are both Superhosts and have even launched a Udemy course on how to be a terrific Airbnb host! 

If there is one website that has truly changed my life, it is Airbnb. 

Now we own properties in some of the places we love the most, including Denver, Colorado --- Steamboat Springs, Colorado --- and Puerto Vallarta, Mexico. We call all of these places “home” and work hard to create an experience for our guests that has all of the conveniences of home but all the pleasures of being on a holiday. 

The Airbnb community is so important to us and has helped us fulfill our dreams. We hope we can have the pleasure of hosting your family at one of our properties and help you create memories that last a lifetime! We can't wait to meet you.

neighborhood_overview:
This property is amazing all year round for a visit to Denver.

The River North Art District "where art is made" goes by the nickname of "RiNo" and has even adopted a rhino design for its official logo, so look for creative rhinos in art and signage all around the neighborhood! The district's interesting blend of urban charm and unique industrial revival makes it a great destination. Historic warehouses and factories now house jazz bars, restaurants, brewpubs, art galleries and working studios. RiNo boasts a diverse mix of creative businesses ranging from visual artists, designers and furniture makers, to craft distillers and brewers, winemakers, creators of unique outdoor gear and small-batch coffee roasters. The art definitely extends beyond gallery walls in this neighborhood, with its colorful and innovative street art murals in alleys and on buildings around almost every corner! Home to everything from music venues, restaurants, breweries, and a plethora of art galleries

neighborhood_overview:
The townhouse is nestled in a vibrant and rapidly evolving RiNo neighborhood, which stands for River North. Located just northeast of downtown Denver, RiNo is known for its vibrant arts scene, trendy restaurants, BREWERIES, and industrial architecture.

One of the main draws of RiNo is its numerous art galleries, studios, and street murals. Make sure to stroll through the neighborhood and admire the colorful street art, or attend one of the monthly art walks to meet local artists and see their work up close.

Foodies will also find plenty to love in RiNo, with various trendy restaurants and breweries. From upscale eateries to casual gastropubs, there's something for every taste and budget.

In addition to its artistic and culinary offerings, RiNo is also home to several unique shops and boutiques and a thriving nightlife scene. You'll be able to catch live music at one of the neighborhood's music venues or enjoy a cocktail at one of its many bars.

We LOVE this city and this state - it has so much to offer visitors and residents. The culture, diversity, performing arts and culinary scene are just a few of the things that make us smile here every day.
We truly enjoy helping people connect to the best of the best local gems, whether it's one of our hidden comedy venues or to the newest and most innovative restaurants. Budtenders can be booked for an informative, fun and unique dispensary tour, to discover the truth behind the cannabis lifestyle in Denver. Gretchen can take you for a progressive happy hour, for "single bite" bests at some Denver's best restaurants off the beaten path.
Looking for comedy, spend an evening with both of us at hidden venues laughing with some of Denver's best local comics.
We are blessed to enjoy a great rapport with our guests and respect their privacy. Please communicate any special needs or concerns about your trip. It's our pleasure to be of service.

The neighborhood is known for its unique and eclectic character, with a mix of historic and modern architecture, as well as a thriving arts scene.

A combination of proximity to downtown, parks, and a newly opened public golf course in addition to a housing stock of early twentieth century homes of craftsman architecture is driving an influx of young professional and their families to the Whittier neighborhood.

neighborhood_overview:
Curtis Park is the original neighborhood in Denver. Come check out beautiful Victorian homes and the neighborhood that started it all. Come for a vacation, leave with a history lesson.

Curtis Park is the creation of the city's first golden age, that time between 1870, when the railroad came to town, and 1893, when the Silver Crash brought a rude end to Denver's early prosperity. During that brief period, the rate of Denver's population growth was higher than that of any other city in the country. From a modest 4,759 in 1870, just twenty years later, in 1890, the city had 106,713 inhabitants. One historian has called it an "instant city."

host_about:
I'm a single, 50-something, friendly and sociable fellow traveler.  

I lead an itinerant home office lifestyle based out of Steamboat Springs and Denver.  (I've been "social distancing" since '94 and 28K baud modems, so I know a thing or two about the now, near dominant work-from-home challenges, setup and rewards. ;) )  

Since growing up in the small town of Eastern Pennsylvania called Nazareth, (Yeah, that's me, I am "Joseph of Nazareth"! ;P ), I have ventured through all 50 United States, and dozens of countries across North America, South America, Africa and Europe.  

My zest for travel stems from experiences in my youth attending grand and exciting "Bon Voyage" and "Welcome Home" parties, and trips to the airport, all dressed up, for family members to all of these unknown and distant places, in particular, Gram's many trips back to our mother country of Austria.  

During my first international month long travels through Europe as a 17 year old, I enjoyed many a serendipitous guest house and hostel stay.  The rest is history.

As an adult, my trips range from weekend road trips to extended multi-month adventurers, for both work as a contracting AppleOS Software Engineer and/or pleasure in pursuit of athletic, cultural and educational endeavors.  

Accommodations during my travels often require an independent, work-from-home and active lifestyle considerations, something I found not to be that readily available.  

After acquiring a single family home in a mountain and ski resort town before the real estate bubble, and then several condominiums immediately after that bubble burst, I found myself in a position to setup and offer my properties and rooms in my house for that "home office" niche.

Fast forward to the internet era, and the embrace and popularity of airbnb.com and the like, I am now able to successfully manage these rental opportunities in an enjoyable and successful manner.  "Who'da thunk". this would have been possible as a youth lusting for travel?!

I take pleasure in hosting my guests' stays at either my private condominiums and rooms in my home.  It's a great way for me to feel "connected" to that itinerant lifestyle while "home'n it".  

I tend to float between these two locations to fathering my 6 year old son in Denver and/or managing rental turnovers.  

I can "hit the ground running" at any of my properties with just a suitcase and gear in tow.  You will be able to as well.

In the interest of learning about your host, some hobbies I enjoy include home improvements, vintage vespas, photography/videography, technology, cooking, brewing beer/mead and volunteering.

I could live just about anywhere, but I chose the endearing community of Steamboat Springs in the beautiful Yampa Valley and all it has to offer.  

I'm more than happy to share my local knowledge and experiences with you during your extended  stay at my house in Steamboat, or at one of my other properties in Denver and Phoenix.

Jim has an unbelievable wealth of knowledge of Colorado microbrews and can be booked to guide you through some of the best local craft breweries, tailored to your specific taste. Budtenders can be booked for an informative, fun and unique dispensary tour, to discover the truth behind the cannabis lifestyle in Denver. Gretchen can take you for a progressive happy hour, for "single bite" bests at some Denver's best restaurants off the beaten path.

We are blessed to enjoy a great rapport with our guests and respect their privacy. Please communicate any special needs or concerns about your trip. It's our pleasure to be of service.
Please check out our other listings if your dates don't coincide with what you see available on the calendar. And feel free to contact us if you don't find availability when you need it, we might be able to help you find another Airbnb listing that works for your needs.

Open since the 1930s, the art deco Mayan Theatre shows independent movies and has a popular bar. Green spaces include Phil Milstein Park, with riverside trails and picnic tables.

As soon as you stroll through the Baker Neighborhood, you notice that it is unique. The neighborhood has the largest collection of Queen Anne Middle Class homes in Denver.

Baker hosts some of the trendiest shops and dining in all of Denver. This Denver neighborhood is a frequent destination for Denver residents and beyond.

neighborhood_overview:
Eat & Drink

The Highlands has one of the highest numbers of food and beverage offerings per capita of any neighborhood in Denver. The area is home to celebrated local restaurants like Spuntino and Cart-Diver; one of the city’s first food halls, Avanti Food & Beverage; and trendy additions such as Daughter Thai Kitchen & Bar and Señor Bear.

That doesn’t mean you can’t find history here. Lechuga’s Italian Restaurant has been around since 1961, and My Brother’s Bar (add a burger to your beer order) is the city’s oldest bar—it’s been operating since 1873.

Imbibers can stroll almost anywhere in the ’hood and find plenty of venues to enjoy craft brews (Denver Beer Co.) or craft cocktails (Lady Jane, Room for Milly) or locally made spirits (Mythology Distillery, the Family Jones Spirit House) or coffee (Queensberry Coffee, Pinwheel Coffee).

name: The Monocle — Designer Black & White Room by RiNo
description:
**Private Room Airbnb, Not a Full-Home Rental.

Step out my front door for the best Denver has to offer! Hunt for colorful street art and breweries in the RiNo Art District and Five Points — both which are just an easy 10 minutes away by foot or 5 minutes by car. After your urban or wilderness adventures, retreat and relax from the comfort of my spectacular home full of designer's eye candy and creature comforts. Colorado is calling. Won't you be my guest?
neighborhood_overview:
The Monocle is in the NE corner of downtown Denver, nestled by a small park on a relatively side cul-de-sac within the historic neighborhood of Whittier. This location offers the best of both worlds: near instant access to the vibrancy of downtown life and the ability to easily retreat from the bustle of it all. Street art and craft brewery fans can walk to the neighboring communities of RiNo and Five Points within minutes to discover countless murals and distilleries that have put Denver on the map. Other popular spots such as LoHi, Ballpark, and City Park are also a quick drive away.

For concertgoers, Denver's two newest venues, Mission Ballroom and Number Thirty Eight are less than 10 minutes away. The Ogden, the Fillmore, the Bluebird and Denver Center for the Performing Arts are less than 15 minutes away.

For conference attendees, the Denver Convention Center is less than 15 minutes away and Gaylord Rockies Resort & Convention Center is about 25 minutes away.

neighborhood_overview:
At just seven by 11 blocks, you can walk the entire Cheesman Park neighborhood in short order, but don’t mistake its small size for lack of action. Packed into those streets is the park itself and its striking, neoclassical-style pavilion, the 24-acre Denver Botanic Gardens, and some diverse dining options.

Eat & Drink
Thump Coffee may be an Oregon import, but we love the community vibe and laptop- and phone-free couch area in the back so much we’ll overlook that it’s not homegrown.

Another Portland transplant, Voodoo Doughnut, is known for delicious fried balls of dough in unexpected flavors (you can get a doughnut topped with bacon or Froot Loops). Speaking of your sweet tooth, there are two venues to get your ice cream fix: family-owned Liks Ice Cream, which has been serving Cheesman Park residents for more than 40 years, and Ice Cream Riot (Pop-Tart ice cream sandwich FTW).

Art and Creativity: RiNo is renowned for its extensive collection of street art and murals. The area is home to numerous galleries, studios, and creative spaces, making it a haven for artists and art enthusiasts.

Craft Breweries and Distilleries: The neighborhood boasts a diverse array of craft breweries and distilleries. Beer enthusiasts can explore the many tasting rooms and taprooms that showcase the city's burgeoning craft beverage scene.

Culinary Scene: RiNo offers a diverse culinary scene with a variety of restaurants, food trucks, and trendy eateries. From upscale dining to casual fare, there's something for every palate.

description: Contact us for shorter stay requests or reduced rates if you are a person with a uterus seeking healthcare. The Tiny Urban Overlook is the culmination of 6 years of dreams. Completed in 2021, our tiny oasis is eco- and community-friendly and full of the amenities you need whilst away from home. From the lofted sleeping area, with  a skylight to see the stars, to the thoughtfully curated local touches, to the easy access to both downtown and the mountains, we know you'll have a delightful stay!
neighborhood_overview:
Mar Lee is a working-class neighborhood with all the charms and realities that come with real folks living their day-to-day lives without the trappings of tourism. Mar Lee is known for its concentration of Asian and Latinx restaurants and shops, its access to the mountains via Highway 6. There are restaurants, breweries, dispensaries, parks, and trails all nearby!

With our guests having access to the internet, we've built a house guide to highlight neighborhood gems and encourage folks to really experience the neighborhood in which they are staying. We've also noted BIPOC, women-owned, LGBTQA+-owned, and eco-friendly spots as supporting these businesses aligns with our values.

We acknowledge that our tiny home sits on the traditional lands of the Cheyenne and Ute peoples and we're committed to uplifting the name of these lands and the community members from these Nations who reside alongside us.

neighborhood_overview:
Victorian-era homes and buildings; lush gardens and parks; hip independently owned shops; art galleries; and restaurants, all make the Lower Highlands (LoHi) neighborhood a great destination. It's our favorite part of Denver!

LoHi is characterized by a mix of old and ultra-modern architecture, some of the city's most innovative restaurants and bars and incredible views of the Highland Bridge and downtown Denver.

In the nearby Tennyson Street Cultural District, you can spend an afternoon browsing antique prints, photographs and paintings from Colorado artists, plus find live music venues and great international foods.

neighborhood_overview:
Denver’s Art District on Santa Fe (ADSF) is a nationally known arts and cultural district, encompassing hundreds of artists, galleries, studios, theaters, and creative businesses along Santa Fe Drive in Denver, Colorado. Founded in 2003, ADSF is a 501(c)(3), nonprofit membership organization and one of the first Certified Creative Districts in the state.

Historically anchored by pioneering spirit, ADSF has long-championed citizen creativity as a cultural crossroads of the city. Thousands visit from the Rocky Mountain region and beyond during the monthly First Friday Art Walks to experience the highest density of art galleries in the country.

While it’s name is rooted in the arts, it’s not only a creative community. The District reflects the neighborhood’s rich, cultural fabric—a symbol of its storied past and bright future. neighborhood_overview: West Washington Park: The neighborhood is considered one of Denver’s most livable spaces. The area has a bubble effect—it sits barely south of Baker’s booming neighborhood and South Broadway dives, west of the ever-busy Washington Park, and walking distance to South Pearl Street, but maintains the air of quiet suburbia perfectly suited for families and professionals. Colloquially known as West Wash Park, the neighborhood is heavily residential, filled with early-20th century houses that have been turned into multi-unit rentals, and offers easy access to a variety of essential and just-for-fun amenities. (Think: grocery stores and fitness clubs, and watering holes and music venues.) Whether you’re a city dweller searching for a new date-night spot, or a Sunday volleyball player looking for a new place to fuel up and wind down after summer games, this residential stalwart offers many fun ways to recharge your routine.

Baker is an historic district just a mile from downtown. You'll find colorful Victorian homes interspersed with more modern architecture. There is a vibrant art community, with many galleries along the Santa Fe Arts District, which hosts First Fridays, an art walk on Santa Fe.

host_about:
We are lucky to professionally host many properties in the Capitol Hill/Uptown/City Park/LoHi/Wash Park/Stapleton areas. We are in our 7th year of hosting and have hosted over 6,000+ stays meeting 10s of thousands of guests from all over the world. We personally greet many of our guests.
Gretchen is an adopted Colorado native of 25 years - 12 years in Vail and 13 fabulous years living in Capitol Hill and Baker in Denver. Jim was born in Denver and his entire family lives here. We LOVE this city and this state - it has so much to offer visitors and residents. The culture, diversity, performing arts and culinary scene are just a few of the things that make us smile here every day.
We truly enjoy helping people connect to the best of the best local gems, whether it's one of our hidden comedy venues or to the newest and most innovative restaurants. Our food truck scene is out of this world, we have the most amazing bands locally and headliners that come from across the country and around the world to perform here.
Jim has an unbelievable wealth of knowledge of Colorado microbrews and can be booked to guide you through some of the best local craft breweries, tailored to your specific taste. Budtenders can be booked for an informative, fun and unique dispensary tour, to discover the truth behind the cannabis lifestyle in Denver. Gretchen can take you for a progressive happy hour, for "single bite" bests at some Denver's best restaurants off the beaten path.
Looking for comedy, spend an evening with both of us at hidden venues laughing with some of Denver's best local comics.
We are blessed to enjoy a great rapport with our guests and respect their privacy. Please communicate any special needs or concerns about your trip. It's our pleasure to be of service.
Please check out our other listings if your dates don't coincide with what you see available on the calendar. And feel free to contact us if you don't find availability when you need it, we might be able to help you find another Airbnb listing that works for your needs. 
On occasion, Gretchen can be of assistance in helping those who are relocating to the area, whether you are looking to rent or buy, contact me with your specifics and I'll see what I can do to help.

neighborhood_overview:
"Victorian-era homes and buildings; lush gardens and parks; hip independently owned shops; art galleries; and restaurants, all make the Denver Highlands neighborhood a great destination for visitors. There are three diverse districts to discover here: Highlands Square, Tennyson Street and Lower Highlands (LoHi). Boutiques, wine shops and bookstores, as well as popular restaurants and bars radiate out from Highland Square on West 32nd Avenue and Lowell Boulevard. And, in the Tennyson Street Cultural District, you can spend an afternoon browsing antique prints, photographs and paintings from Colorado artists, plus find live music venues and great ethnic foods. host_about: I'm an artist from Denver, CO and have traveled to over 45 countries. Most of my work is inspired by my time abroad. Currently I'm exploring the intersections between ecology, fine art and community acts of preservation & restoration. I'm also inspired by my son, with whom I'm excited to continue exploring the world. From the time he was born, I became very concerned with how we grow and consume food and maintain involvement with a Slow Food approach to celebratory activism around the shared table. In this context I look at plant mobilities and how to encourage the preservation of unique identities expressed through culinary traditions, while focusing on localization and farming practices that work in harmony with the environment. Establishing networks of living seed libraries and using technology to invite community members to creatively engage with the land are at the core of my creative practice. Ongoing projects are underway in Ireland, Colorado, New Mexico, Morocco, Maine and Haiti.

City Park West

Our neighborhood gets its name from the nearby 314-acre park, which is also the home of the adorable residents at the Denver Zoo. You’ll see plenty of locals commuting — by bike and car — between the city’s west side and downtown. To the south, East 17th and East Colfax avenues are bustling cultural corridors that draw people of all ages to their buzzing blocks.

While primarily residential, there are several bars, restaurants and stores within walking distance, and the neighborhood is situated between two new industrial redevelopments - Denver Rock Drill and York Street Yards, linked by the 39th Avenue Greenway Trail - which bring new food, drink and entertainment options to the neighborhood on seemingly a daily basis. The majority of homes in the neighborhood date to the early 1900s, and a walk down just about any street will highlight multiple different architectural styles.

Most importantly for travelers, the neighborhood provides easy transportation access via I-70 or the light rail to the airport, and close proximity to some of Denver's most exciting places to explore, all while providing a return to quiet, comfortable accommodations at the end of the day.

neighborhood_overview:
Cultures blend in historic Five Points, one of Denver's oldest and most diverse neighborhoods. The district was known as the "Harlem of the West" because it was a frequent stop for jazz greats including Billie Holiday, Louis Armstrong and Miles Davis, who played clubs like the Rossonian and the Rainbow Room. The neighborhood was also mentioned repeatedly in Jack Kerouac's "On the Road."

Today, historic Five Points' creativity and vibrancy live on in a fascinating fusion of old and new. Visitors can stop in at innovative coffeehouses and craft breweries, visit museums telling stories from the past, experience live music from all genres at independent music venues or eat at beloved soul food and barbecue institutions.

Originally annexed as the Town of North Denver, the Berkeley neighborhood has set the stage for some of Denver's most well known names. Historic giants like Elitch's (Zoological) Gardens, whose original theatre is still located at 38th and Tennyson, helped to create the vibrant cultural landscape unique to the neighborhood and its history. Colloquially known as West Wash Park, the neighborhood is heavily residential, filled with early-20th century houses that have been turned into multi-unit rentals, and offers easy access to a variety of essential and just-for-fun amenities. neighborhood_overview:
The 7th Avenue Historic District
From containing the residence of the Summer White House during the Eisenhower administration to being home of the inventor of the ice cream soda, the East 7th Avenue Historic District is one of the most interesting and beautiful in Denver.

Primarily built from the 1890’s to the 1930’s, the East 7th Avenue Historic District is the largest in Denver with its boundaries stretching from Logan Street to Colorado Avenue, and from 6th Avenue to 8th Avenue. Between Steele and Harrison Streets, the district is limited to the 7th Avenue Parkway. Because Downing Street was a main thoroughfare in the late 1890’s, the earliest construction in the district is found nearby on the 700 Blocks of Corona and Marion. 7th and Williams Street contained a stable for horses that used the Cheesman Esplanade, or “Little Cheesman”, for their exercising. neighborhood_overview:
Denver's Baker and Santa Fe neighborhoods are two of the most vibrant and eclectic areas in the city. Located just south of downtown Denver, these neighborhoods offer a unique blend of old-world charm and modern urban living, making them popular among residents and visitors alike.

Baker, also known as the Baker Historic District, is known for its stunning Victorian-era homes, tree-lined streets, and lively arts and culture scene. The neighborhood was founded in the late 19th century and has retained much of its historic character, with many of its original buildings still standing. Baker is home to a diverse community of artists, musicians, and creatives, and is known for its many galleries, studios, and performance spaces. The area is also home to some of Denver's most popular restaurants, bars, and cafes, making it a hub of activity both day and night.

Just to the west of Baker lies the Santa Fe Arts District, which is another popular destination for art lovers

neighborhood_overview: The River North Art District "where art is made" goes by the nickname of "RiNo" and has even adopted a rhino design for its official logo, so look for creative rhinos in art and signage all around the neighborhood! The district's interesting blend of urban charm and unique industrial revival makes it a great destination for visitors. Historic warehouses and factories now house jazz bars, restaurants, brewpubs, art galleries and working studios. RiNo boasts a diverse mix of creative businesses ranging from visual artists, designers and furniture makers, to craft distillers and brewers, winemakers, creators of unique outdoor gear and small-batch coffee roasters. host_about:
Thank you for considering one of our listings! 

Our company owns multiple units in the downtown Denver high rise, Brooks Tower Residences. When not in use for our corporate housing needs, we rent them to travelers on a 30+ day basis. All units are professionally managed by us and our in-house maintenance staff, and professionally cleaned in between guests.  Monthly rent includes a furnished unit, building amenities, all utilities, &Wi-Fi access.
